-- SQLite schema for the local betting-research dashboard.
-- odds_snapshots is append-only: rows are never updated or deleted.

PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    event_uid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sport TEXT NOT NULL,
    league TEXT NOT NULL,
    participant_ids TEXT,
    start_at TEXT,
    market_close_at TEXT,
    mapping_confidence REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canonical_events (
    event_uid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sport TEXT NOT NULL,
    league TEXT NOT NULL,
    participant_ids TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON array of strings
    start_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    mapping_confidence REAL NOT NULL,
    market_close_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS participants (
    participant_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sport TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_aliases (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    bookmaker TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (bookmaker, source_event_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS market_types (
    market TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sport TEXT,
    description TEXT,
    outcomes TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS odds_snapshots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    bookmaker TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    line REAL,
    odds_decimal REAL NOT NULL,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_event_id TEXT,
    source_url TEXT,
    adapter_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_live INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_live IN (0, 1)),
    line_key REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT -1e308,
    UNIQUE (event_uid, bookmaker, market, outcome, line_key, observed_at, adapter_version)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_odds_snapshots_event_observed
    ON odds_snapshots (event_uid, observed_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS results (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    participant_a TEXT,
    participant_b TEXT,
    score TEXT,
    league TEXT,
    event_date TEXT,
    source TEXT,
    comment TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
    UNIQUE (event_uid, source)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feature_values (
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    feature TEXT NOT NULL,
    value REAL NOT NULL,
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    as_of TEXT NOT NULL,
    transform_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_uid, feature, as_of, transform_version)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS predictions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    prediction_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    model_run_id TEXT,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    line REAL,
    model_prob REAL NOT NULL,
    odds_decimal REAL,
    bookmaker TEXT,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision_observed_at TEXT,
    event_start_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
    closing_odds REAL,
    clv REAL,
    actual_outcome INTEGER,
    settled_at TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prediction_outcomes (
    prediction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_prob REAL NOT NULL,
    odds_decimal REAL,
    actual INTEGER NOT NULL,
    brier REAL NOT NULL,
    log_loss REAL NOT NULL,
    clv REAL,
    settled_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prediction_outcomes_event ON prediction_outcomes(event_uid);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prediction_result_links (
    prediction_event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    result_event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    confidence REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (prediction_event_uid, result_event_uid)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS score_distributions (
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    model_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('empirical', 'markov', 'blend')),
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    distribution_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    p1_prob REAL NOT NULL,
    blend_weight REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_uid, model_run_id, provider)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_score_distributions_event ON score_distributions(event_uid);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_runs (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    features_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    metrics_json TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adapter_health (
    bookmaker TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_success TEXT,
    error_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    adapter_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_error TEXT,
    rows_last_poll INTEGER,
    payload_hash TEXT,
    freshness_sec REAL
);

-- Closing lines: last pre-start odds snapshot per (event, market, outcome)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS closing_lines (
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    line REAL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    odds_closing REAL NOT NULL,
    bookmaker TEXT,
    captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_uid, market, line, outcome)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_closing_event ON closing_lines(event_uid);

-- Per-bookmaker closing lines. CLV must compare the same book's decision and
-- closing price; a cross-book max is not comparable when books list the
-- participants in different p1/p2 order.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS closing_lines_book (
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    line REAL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    bookmaker TEXT NOT NULL,
    odds_closing REAL NOT NULL,
    captured_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_uid, market, line, outcome, bookmaker)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_closing_book_event ON closing_lines_book(event_uid);

-- Personal bet journal
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bets (
    bet_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    prediction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    line REAL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    stake REAL NOT NULL,
    odds_taken REAL NOT NULL,
    bookmaker TEXT,
    placed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at TEXT,
    result INTEGER,
    pnl REAL,
    bankroll_before REAL,
    bankroll_after REAL,
    notes TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bets_event ON bets(event_uid);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bets_pending ON bets(settled_at) WHERE settled_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bankroll (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO bankroll(id, amount, updated_at) VALUES (1, 0, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tournaments (
    tournament_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    tour TEXT,
    surface TEXT,
    court_pace_index REAL,
    altitude_m REAL,
    ball_brand TEXT,
    ball_speed_factor REAL,
    ball_softness REAL,
    notes TEXT,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

"""One-time migration helpers for the tennis-only project scope."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from betdash.db.repository import Repository

DEPENDENT_TABLES = (
    "odds_snapshots",
    "predictions",
    "results",
    "closing_lines",
    "closing_lines_book",
    "event_aliases",
    "feature_values",
    "bets",
    "events",
)


def _quote(name: str) -> str:
    return '"' + name.replace('"', '""') + '"'


def _columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str) -> set[str]:
    return {row[1] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA main.table_info({_quote(table)})")}


def prepare_connection(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Make a live migration safe under concurrent readers/writers."""
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)")


def _purge_predicate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str) -> str | None:
    cols = _columns(conn, table)
    if table == "canonical_events":
        return "(sport IS NULL OR sport <> 'tennis')"
    parts: list[str] = []
    if "sport" in cols:
        parts.append("(sport IS NULL OR sport <> 'tennis')")
    if "event_uid" in cols:
        parts.append("event_uid IN (SELECT event_uid FROM _purge_uids)")
    return " OR ".join(parts) if parts else None


def archive_and_purge_non_tennis(
    repo: Repository, archive_path: Path
) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
    """Archive non-tennis rows into ``archive_path`` and purge them from ``repo``.

    Returns a report keyed by table. ``canonical_events`` counts are keyed by
    sport; every other table uses a single ``rows`` key.
    """
    db_path = Path(repo.path)
    archive_path = Path(archive_path)
    archive_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    archive_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_path))
    try:
        prepare_connection(conn)
        conn.execute("ATTACH DATABASE ? AS archive", (str(archive_path),))
        tables = [
            row[0]
            for row in conn.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM main.sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
            )
        ]
        for table in tables:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT sql FROM main.sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = ?",
                (table,),
            ).fetchone()
            if row and row[0]:
                conn.execute(f"CREATE TABLE archive.{_quote(table)} ({row[0].split('(', 1)[1] if '(' in row[0] else ''}")

        conn.execute(
            """
            CREATE TEMP TABLE _purge_uids AS
            SELECT event_uid FROM main.canonical_events
            WHERE (sport IS NULL OR sport <> 'tennis') AND event_uid IS NOT NULL
            """
        )
        for table in tables:
            if table == "canonical_events" or "event_uid" not in _columns(conn, table):
                continue
            conn.execute(
                f"""
                INSERT INTO _purge_uids(event_uid)
                SELECT DISTINCT t.event_uid FROM main.{_quote(table)} t
                WHERE t.event_uid IS NOT NULL
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM main.canonical_events e WHERE e.event_uid = t.event_uid
                  )
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM _purge_uids p WHERE p.event_uid = t.event_uid
                  )
                """
            )

        report: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
        predicates: dict[str, str] = {}
        for table in tables:
            predicate = _purge_predicate(conn, table)
            if predicate is None:
                continue
            predicates[table] = predicate
            conn.execute(
                f"INSERT INTO archive.{_quote(table)} SELECT * FROM main.{_quote(table)} WHERE {predicate}"
            )
            if table == "canonical_events":
                report[table] = {
                    str(sport or ""): int(count)
                    for sport, count in conn.execute(
                        "SELECT sport, COUNT(*) FROM archive.canonical_events GROUP BY sport"
                    )
                }
            else:
                count = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM archive.{_quote(table)}").fetchone()[0]
                report[table] = {"rows": int(count)}

        for table in reversed(tables):
            predicate = predicates.get(table)
            if predicate is None:
                continue
            conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM main.{_quote(table)} WHERE {predicate}")
        conn.commit()
        conn.execute("DETACH DATABASE archive")
        conn.execute("VACUUM")
        return report
    finally:
        conn.close()


def migrate_checkpoint(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Remove non-tennis rating keys from a trainer checkpoint in place."""
    path = Path(path)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    removed: dict[str, int] = {}
    for section in ("elo", "glicko"):
        ratings = payload.get(section)
        if not isinstance(ratings, dict):
            continue
        before = set(ratings)
        payload[section] = {key: value for key, value in ratings.items() if key == "tennis"}
        removed[section] = len(before - set(payload[section]))
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(path)
    return removed


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    """CLI entry point used once against the live database."""
    from betdash.config import Settings

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Archive and purge non-tennis data")
    parser.add_argument("--db", default=str(Settings().db_path))
    parser.add_argument("--archive", default="data/archive/non-tennis-2026-11-27.sqlite")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", default="data/checkpoints/trainer_checkpoint.json")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    checkpoint_path = Path(args.checkpoint)
    checkpoint_payload = json.loads(checkpoint_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(checkpoint_payload, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"Checkpoint must contain a JSON object: {checkpoint_path}")
    report = archive_and_purge_non_tennis(Repository(args.db), Path(args.archive))
    report["checkpoint"] = migrate_checkpoint(checkpoint_path)
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Resilient polling collector for bookmaker adapters."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from threading import Lock
from typing import Any

from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler

from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import AdapterHealth, Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.normalize import MVP_SPORTS, EntityRegistry, canon_market, canon_sport, canonical_outcome, normalize_event
from betdash.normalize.models import RawOdd


class Collector:
    """Poll adapters, normalize quotes, and persist immutable snapshots."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        settings: Settings,
        repository: Repository,
        adapters: list[Any],
        registry: EntityRegistry,
    ) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.repository = repository
        self.adapters = adapters
        self.registry = registry
        self._scheduler: BackgroundScheduler | None = None
        self._lock = Lock()
        self._error_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        self._last_success: dict[str, datetime | None] = {}
        self._adapter_versions: dict[str, str] = {}
        self._seed_health_from_repository()

    def poll_once(self) -> int:
        """Poll all adapters once. Never raises to caller."""
        with self._lock:
            return self._poll_once_locked()

    def _seed_health_from_repository(self) -> None:
        try:
            rows = self.repository.list_adapter_health() if hasattr(self.repository, "list_adapter_health") else self.repository.adapter_health()
        except Exception:
            return
        if not rows:
            return
        for row in rows:
            self._error_counts[row.bookmaker] = row.error_count
            self._last_success[row.bookmaker] = row.last_success
            self._adapter_versions[row.bookmaker] = row.adapter_version

    def _ensure_bookmaker_state(self, adapter: Any, bookmaker: str) -> None:
        if bookmaker in self._error_counts:
            return
        try:
            rows = self.repository.list_adapter_health() if hasattr(self.repository, "list_adapter_health") else self.repository.adapter_health()
        except Exception:
            rows = []
        for row in rows or []:
            if row.bookmaker != bookmaker:
                continue
            self._error_counts[bookmaker] = row.error_count
            self._last_success[bookmaker] = row.last_success
            self._adapter_versions[bookmaker] = row.adapter_version
            return
        self._error_counts.setdefault(bookmaker, 0)
        self._last_success.setdefault(bookmaker, None)
        try:
            self._adapter_versions.setdefault(bookmaker, self._adapter_version(adapter))
        except Exception:
            self._adapter_versions.setdefault(bookmaker, "unknown")

    def _poll_once_locked(self) -> int:
        for adapter in self.adapters:
            self._ensure_bookmaker_state(adapter, self._bookmaker(adapter))

        snapshots: list[Snapshot] = []
        events: dict[str, Any] = {}
        ready: list[tuple[Any, str, int, str, set[str]]] = []

        for adapter, bookmaker, raw_odds, fetch_error in self._fetch_all_adapters():
            if fetch_error is not None:
                self._mark_degraded(adapter, bookmaker, last_error=fetch_error, rows_last_poll=0)
                continue

            if not raw_odds:
                self._mark_degraded(adapter, bookmaker, last_error="empty_snapshot", rows_last_poll=0)
                continue

            payload_hash = str(abs(hash(tuple((getattr(r,'event_uid',getattr(r,'source_event_id','')),getattr(r,'market',''),getattr(r,'outcome',''),getattr(r,'line',None),getattr(r,'odds_decimal',None)) for r in raw_odds[:500]))))
            try:
                normalized, canonicals, had_persistable = self._normalize_fetched(adapter, raw_odds)
            except Exception as exc:
                self._mark_degraded(adapter, bookmaker, last_error=f"ingest:{type(exc).__name__}", rows_last_poll=len(raw_odds), payload_hash=payload_hash)
                continue

            if not had_persistable:
                self._mark_degraded(adapter, bookmaker, last_error="no_persistable_rows", rows_last_poll=len(raw_odds), payload_hash=payload_hash)
                continue

            snapshots.extend(normalized)
            events.update(canonicals)
            contributed = {str(snapshot.event_uid) for snapshot in normalized}
            ready.append((adapter, bookmaker, len(raw_odds), payload_hash, contributed))

        if not snapshots:
            return 0
        failed_events: dict[str, str] = {}
        for uid, canonical in events.items():
            try:
                self.repository.upsert_canonical_event(canonical)
            except Exception as exc:
                failed_events[uid] = f"persist:{type(exc).__name__}"

        try:
            saved = self.repository.save_snapshots(self._dedupe_snapshots(snapshots))
        except Exception as exc:
            for adapter, bookmaker, rows, payload_hash, _ in ready:
                self._mark_degraded(adapter, bookmaker, last_error=f"persist:{type(exc).__name__}", rows_last_poll=rows, payload_hash=payload_hash)
            return 0

        for adapter, bookmaker, rows, payload_hash, contributed in ready:
            failure = next((failed_events[uid] for uid in contributed if uid in failed_events), None)
            if failure is not None:
                self._mark_degraded(adapter, bookmaker, last_error=failure, rows_last_poll=rows, payload_hash=payload_hash)
            else:
                self._mark_ok(adapter, bookmaker, rows_last_poll=rows, payload_hash=payload_hash)
        return saved

    def _fetch_all_adapters(self) -> list[tuple[Any, str, list[RawOdd] | None, str | None]]:
        """Fetch all adapters concurrently, preserving submission order."""
        if not self.adapters:
            return []

        def fetch(adapter: Any) -> tuple[Any, str, list[RawOdd] | None, str | None]:
            bookmaker = self._bookmaker(adapter)
            try:
                return adapter, bookmaker, list(adapter.fetch_snapshot() or []), None
            except Exception as exc:
                return adapter, bookmaker, None, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(4, len(self.adapters))) as pool:
            futures = [pool.submit(fetch, adapter) for adapter in self.adapters]
            return [future.result() for future in futures]

    def _normalize_fetched(
        self, adapter: Any, raw_odds: list[RawOdd]
    ) -> tuple[list[Snapshot], dict[str, Any], bool]:
        snapshots: list[Snapshot] = []
        events: dict[str, Any] = {}
        had_persistable = False
        for raw in raw_odds:
            try:
                if raw.is_live:
                    continue
                sport = canon_sport(raw.sport)
                market = canon_market(raw.market, raw.bookmaker)
                if sport not in MVP_SPORTS:
                    continue
                if market.startswith("unknown_") and len(tuple(getattr(raw, "participants", ()) or ())) < 2:
                    # Stat/prop noise often has no two-sided event identity.
                    continue
                canonical = normalize_event(raw, self.registry)
                if canonical.mapping_confidence < 0.5:
                    continue
                snapshot = Snapshot(
                    event_uid=canonical.event_uid,
                    bookmaker=raw.bookmaker,
                    market=market,
                    outcome=canonical_outcome(raw, canonical),
                    line=getattr(raw, "line", None),
                    odds_decimal=raw.odds_decimal,
                    observed_at=raw.observed_at,
                    source_event_id=raw.source_event_id,
                    adapter_version=self._adapter_version(adapter),
                    is_live=raw.is_live,
                    source_url=getattr(raw, "source_url", None),
                )
                snapshots.append(snapshot)
                events[canonical.event_uid] = canonical
                had_persistable = True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return snapshots, events, had_persistable

    @staticmethod
    def _dedupe_snapshots(snapshots: list[Snapshot]) -> list[Snapshot]:
        def key(snapshot: Snapshot) -> tuple[str, ...]:
            return (
                str(snapshot.event_uid),
                str(snapshot.bookmaker),
                str(snapshot.market),
                str(snapshot.outcome),
                str(snapshot.line),
                str(snapshot.observed_at),
                str(snapshot.source_event_id),
                str(snapshot.adapter_version),
            )

        seen: set[tuple[str, ...]] = set()
        result: list[Snapshot] = []
        for snapshot in sorted(snapshots, key=key):
            identity = key(snapshot)
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            result.append(snapshot)
        return result

    def start(self) -> None:
        """Register periodic polling using Settings.poll_seconds."""
        with self._lock:
            if self._scheduler is not None:
                return
            scheduler = BackgroundScheduler()
            scheduler.add_job(
                self.poll_once,
                "interval",
                seconds=self.settings.poll_seconds,
                max_instances=1,
                coalesce=True,
            )
            scheduler.start()
            self._scheduler = scheduler

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Shut scheduler down cleanly."""
        with self._lock:
            scheduler = self._scheduler
            self._scheduler = None
        if scheduler is not None:
            scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)

    def health(self) -> list[AdapterHealth]:
        """Return current adapter health known to collector/repository."""
        if hasattr(self.repository, "list_adapter_health"):
            return self.repository.list_adapter_health()
        return self.repository.adapter_health()

    def _mark_ok(self, adapter: Any, bookmaker: str, *, rows_last_poll: int | None = None, payload_hash: str | None = None) -> None:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        self._error_counts[bookmaker] = 0
        self._last_success[bookmaker] = now
        version = self._adapter_version(adapter)
        self._adapter_versions[bookmaker] = version
        freshness = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - now).total_seconds()
        self._upsert_health(bookmaker, "ok", now, 0, version, last_error=None, rows_last_poll=rows_last_poll, payload_hash=payload_hash, freshness_sec=freshness)

    def _mark_degraded(self, adapter: Any, bookmaker: str, *, last_error: str | None = None, rows_last_poll: int | None = None, payload_hash: str | None = None) -> None:
        self._error_counts[bookmaker] = self._error_counts.get(bookmaker, 0) + 1
        version = self._adapter_version(adapter)
        self._adapter_versions[bookmaker] = version
        last_success = self._last_success.get(bookmaker)
        try:
            adapter_health = adapter.health()
            if last_success is None:
                last_success = adapter_health.last_success
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._last_success[bookmaker] = last_success
        freshness = None
        if last_success is not None:
            freshness = max(0.0, (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - last_success).total_seconds())
        self._upsert_health(
            bookmaker,
            "degraded",
            last_success,
            self._error_counts[bookmaker],
            version,
            last_error=last_error,
            rows_last_poll=rows_last_poll,
            payload_hash=payload_hash,
            freshness_sec=freshness,
        )

    def _upsert_health(
        self,
        bookmaker: str,
        status: str,
        last_success: datetime | None,
        error_count: int,
        adapter_version: str,
        *,
        last_error: str | None = None,
        rows_last_poll: int | None = None,
        payload_hash: str | None = None,
        freshness_sec: float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        health = AdapterHealth(
            bookmaker=bookmaker,
            status=status,
            last_success=last_success,
            error_count=error_count,
            adapter_version=adapter_version,
            last_error=last_error,
            rows_last_poll=rows_last_poll,
            payload_hash=payload_hash,
            freshness_sec=freshness_sec,
        )
        # Support brief interface and existing repository.
        if hasattr(self.repository, "adapter_health_upsert"):
            self.repository.adapter_health_upsert(health)
            return
        if hasattr(self.repository, "upsert_adapter_health"):
            self.repository.upsert_adapter_health(health)
            return
        # brief-named method form
        if callable(getattr(self.repository, "adapter_health", None)):
            try:
                # Try brief signature: adapter_health(bookmaker, status, last_success, error_count, adapter_version)
                self.repository.adapter_health(bookmaker, status, last_success, error_count, adapter_version)  # type: ignore[misc]
                return
            except TypeError:
                pass
        self.repository.upsert_adapter_health(health)

    def _bookmaker(self, adapter: Any) -> str:
        try:
            health = adapter.health()
            if health.bookmaker:
                return health.bookmaker
        except Exception:
            pass
        return str(getattr(adapter, "bookmaker", "unknown"))

    def _adapter_version(self, adapter: Any) -> str:
        try:
            version = adapter.health().adapter_version
            if version:
                return version
        except Exception:
            pass
        return str(getattr(adapter, "adapter_version", "unknown"))

FILE: src/betdash/live/sofascore.py

"""Tiny public SofaScore live-events client (no API key)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any
from urllib.request import urlopen

BASE_URL = "https://api.sofascore.com/api/v1"
_TIMEOUT = 5
_SUPPORTED = {"tennis"}
_LIVE_CACHE: dict[str, tuple[float, list[dict[str, Any]]]] = {}


def _clear_live_cache() -> None:
    _LIVE_CACHE.clear()


def _name(team: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    translations = team.get("fieldTranslations") or {}
    translated = (translations.get("nameTranslation") or {}).get("ru")
    return str(translated or team.get("name") or "")


def _row(event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    event_id = event.get("id")
    start = event.get("startTimestamp")
    start_at = (
        datetime.fromtimestamp(int(start), timezone.utc).isoformat()
        if isinstance(start, (int, float)) or str(start or "").isdigit()
        else ""
    )
    return {
        "event_id": event_id,
        "start_at": start_at,
        "home": _name(event.get("homeTeam") or {}),
        "away": _name(event.get("awayTeam") or {}),
        "home_score": (event.get("homeScore") or {}).get("current"),
        "away_score": (event.get("awayScore") or {}).get("current"),
        "status": str((event.get("status") or {}).get("description") or ""),
        "tournament": str((event.get("tournament") or {}).get("name") or ""),
        "url": f"https://www.sofascore.com/event/{event_id}",
    }


def _load_live_events(sport: str, opener: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if str(sport).casefold() not in _SUPPORTED:
        return []
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/sport/{sport}/events/live"
    with opener(url, timeout=_TIMEOUT) as response:
        payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
    events = payload.get("events") or []
    return [_row(event) for event in events if isinstance(event, dict)]


def fetch_live_events(sport: str, opener: Any = urlopen) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Fetch live events, returning an empty list on any network/parse error."""
    try:
        return _load_live_events(sport, opener)
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        return []


def _now_value(now: Any) -> float:
    if now is None:
        return time.monotonic()
    if callable(now):
        return float(now())
    return float(now)


def _cached_rows(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], stale: bool) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [dict(row, _stale=stale) for row in rows]


def fetch_live_events_cached(
    sport: str,
    opener: Any = urlopen,
    ttl_seconds: float = 30,
    max_fallback_age_seconds: float = 300,
    now: Any = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Fetch live events with a short TTL and a bounded last-good fallback."""
    key = str(sport).casefold()
    current = _now_value(now)
    ttl = max(0.0, float(ttl_seconds))
    max_fallback_age = max(0.0, float(max_fallback_age_seconds))
    cached = _LIVE_CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is not None and current - cached[0] < ttl:
        return _cached_rows(cached[1], False)
    try:
        rows = _load_live_events(sport, opener)
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError):
        if cached is not None and current - cached[0] <= ttl + max_fallback_age:
            return _cached_rows(cached[1], True)
        return []
    stored = _cached_rows(rows, False)
    _LIVE_CACHE[key] = (current, stored)
    return _cached_rows(stored, False)

FILE: src/betdash/markets/consensus.py

"""Consensus benchmark probabilities across bookmakers.

De-vig and consensus are benchmarks, not truth. Signals with fewer than two
qualifying books have zero benchmark coverage.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from betdash.db.repository import Snapshot
from betdash.markets.de_vig import implied_probs


def consensus_prob(snapshots: list[Snapshot], outcome: str) -> tuple[float, int]:
    """Return (consensus probability, coverage) for an outcome.

    Each bookmaker is de-vigged separately. Only books with at least two
    outcomes present are included. Coverage is the number of qualifying books.
    When coverage < 2, returns ``(0.0, coverage)``.
    """
    by_book: dict[str, list[Snapshot]] = {}
    for snap in snapshots:
        by_book.setdefault(snap.bookmaker, []).append(snap)

    probs: list[float] = []
    coverage = 0
    for book_snaps in by_book.values():
        # Latest snapshot per outcome for this bookmaker.
        latest_by_outcome: dict[str, Snapshot] = {}
        for snap in book_snaps:
            prev = latest_by_outcome.get(snap.outcome)
            if prev is None or snap.observed_at >= prev.observed_at:
                latest_by_outcome[snap.outcome] = snap

        if len(latest_by_outcome) < 2:
            continue
        if outcome not in latest_by_outcome:
            continue

        outcomes = list(latest_by_outcome.keys())
        odds = [latest_by_outcome[o].odds_decimal for o in outcomes]
        devigged = implied_probs(odds)
        outcome_prob = devigged[outcomes.index(outcome)]
        probs.append(outcome_prob)
        coverage += 1

    if coverage < 2:
        return 0.0, coverage
    return sum(probs) / len(probs), coverage


def best_price(snapshots: list[Snapshot], outcome: str) -> float | None:
    """Return the maximum available decimal odds for an outcome, or None."""
    prices = [snap.odds_decimal for snap in snapshots if snap.outcome == outcome]
    if not prices:
        return None
    return max(prices)


def clv_included(has_close_snapshot: bool) -> bool:
    """CLV uses consensus at market_close_at.

    No closing snapshot means the signal is excluded from CLV but kept in
    other metrics. This helper encodes that rule for downstream consumers.
    """

    return bool(has_close_snapshot)




FILE: src/betdash/markets/de_vig.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"""De-vig utilities for normalizing bookmaker margins."""

from __future__ import annotations


def implied_probs(odds: list[float]) -> list[float]:
    """Normalize inverse decimal odds so probabilities sum to 1.

    This removes the bookmaker margin proportionally across outcomes.
    """
    if not odds:
        return []
    if any(o <= 0 for o in odds):
        raise ValueError("odds must be positive")

    inverses = [1.0 / o for o in odds]
    total = sum(inverses)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid odds total")
    return [inv / total for inv in inverses]

"""Baseline rating models.

Ratings are per-sport in the trainer; these classes hold rating state
and provide probability(a, b).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from math import isfinite, pi, sqrt


def score_margin(score: str | None) -> float:
    """Total game margin from a tennis score such as ``6-4 7-5``.

    Tiebreak numbers are ignored; only pairs of set scores contribute.
    Missing or unparseable scores return 0.0 (neutral WElo weight).
    """
    clean = re.sub(r"\([^)]*\)", " ", str(score or ""))
    nums = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"\d+", clean)]
    return float(sum(abs(nums[i] - nums[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(nums) - 1, 2)))


def _welo_weight(margin: float | None) -> float:
    """Normalized Kovalchik WElo weight, bounded for local K=20 stability."""
    try:
        value = max(0.0, float(margin))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 1.0
    if not isfinite(value):
        return 1.0
    return min(2.0, max(0.75, ((value + 5.0) / 5.0) ** 0.4))


@dataclass
class EloRating:
    k: float = 20.0
    base: float = 1500.0
    ratings: dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def get(self, player: str) -> float:
        return float(self.ratings.get(player, self.base))

    def probability(self, a: str, b: str) -> float:
        ra = self.get(a)
        rb = self.get(b)
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + 10 ** ((rb - ra) / 400.0))

    def update(
        self, a: str, b: str, score_a: float, weight: float = 1.0
    ) -> None:
        # Clamp to [0, 1] to keep rating state bounded even if callers pass
        # an out-of-range value by mistake. NaN is treated as a draw.
        try:
            score = float(score_a)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            score = 0.5
        score = 0.5 if not isfinite(score) else min(max(score, 0.0), 1.0)
        try:
            safe_weight = min(2.0, max(0.75, float(weight)))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            safe_weight = 1.0
        if not isfinite(safe_weight):
            safe_weight = 1.0
        pa = self.probability(a, b)
        ra = self.get(a)
        rb = self.get(b)
        step = self.k * safe_weight
        self.ratings[a] = ra + step * (score - pa)
        self.ratings[b] = rb + step * ((1.0 - score) - (1.0 - pa))


@dataclass
class GlickoState:
    rating: float = 1500.0
    rd: float = 350.0


@dataclass
class GlickoRating:
    """Lightweight Glicko-like rating for baseline probabilities.

    Uses Glicko-1 style g(RD) scaling with fixed volatility for MVP.
    update() uses a simplified heuristic (RD *= 0.98) rather than the
    full Glicko-1 formula with d^2 and volatility.
    """

    base: float = 1500.0
    q: float = 0.00575646273  # ln(10) / 400
    ratings: dict[str, GlickoState] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def get(self, player: str) -> GlickoState:
        state = self.ratings.get(player)
        if state is None:
            state = GlickoState(rating=self.base, rd=350.0)
            self.ratings[player] = state
        return state

    def _peek(self, player: str) -> GlickoState:
        """Read-only accessor: does not create state on lookup."""
        state = self.ratings.get(player)
        if state is None:
            return GlickoState(rating=self.base, rd=350.0)
        return state

    @staticmethod
    def _g(rd: float, q: float) -> float:
        return 1.0 / sqrt(1.0 + (3.0 * q * q * rd * rd) / (pi * pi))

    def probability(self, a: str, b: str) -> float:
        ra = self._peek(a)
        rb = self._peek(b)
        g = self._g(sqrt(ra.rd * ra.rd + rb.rd * rb.rd), self.q)
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + 10 ** (-g * (ra.rating - rb.rating) / 400.0))

    def update(self, a: str, b: str, score_a: float) -> None:
        score_a = min(max(float(score_a), 0.0), 1.0)
        pa = self.probability(a, b)
        ra = self.get(a)
        rb = self.get(b)
        k = 24.0
        ra.rating = ra.rating + k * (score_a - pa)
        rb.rating = rb.rating + k * ((1.0 - score_a) - (1.0 - pa))
        ra.rd = max(30.0, ra.rd * 0.98)
        rb.rd = max(30.0, rb.rd * 0.98)

"""Feature extraction for baseline models.

All features must be computed with information observed before the event
starts. Callers should pass events whose snapshots/results are filtered
by as_of/start to prevent future leakage.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path

import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.normalize.registry import normalize_name


def _to_dt(value: str | datetime | None) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        dt = value
    else:
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return None
    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def _safe_float(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        result = float(value)
        return result if math.isfinite(result) else default
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _parse_result_date(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    raw = str(value or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return None
    for fmt in (None, "%d/%m/%Y", "%d.%m.%Y"):
        try:
            if fmt is None:
                dt = datetime.fromisoformat(raw.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
            else:
                dt = datetime.strptime(raw, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if dt.tzinfo is None:
            return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    return None


def _winner_from_score(score: str) -> str | None:
    from betdash.tennis.score import tennis_winner_side
    return tennis_winner_side(str(score or ""))


def _norm_pid(value: str) -> str:
    from betdash.normalize.registry import normalize_name
    text = str(value or "")
    for prefix in ("name:", "unresolved:", "ambiguous:", "resolved:"):
        if text.startswith(prefix):
            text = text[len(prefix):]
            break
    return normalize_name(text)




_SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP: dict[str, str] | None = None


def clear_sackmann_alias_cache() -> None:
    """Drop cached player aliases after the alias file changes."""
    global _SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP
    _SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP = None


def _sackmann_player_alias_map() -> dict[str, str]:
    global _SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP
    if _SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP is None:
        path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "normalize" / "sackmann_aliases.json"
        raw = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        result: dict[str, str] = {}
        for canonical, aliases in raw.items():
            for alias in aliases:
                key = normalize_name(alias)
                if key:
                    result.setdefault(key, canonical)
        _SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP = result
    return _SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP


def _sackmann_canonical_name(value: str) -> str:
    normalized = _norm_pid(value)
    if not normalized:
        return normalized
    canonical = _sackmann_player_alias_map().get(normalized)
    return normalized if canonical is None else normalize_name(canonical)


SACKMANN_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 8
_SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE: dict[tuple[str, str, int], list[tuple[Any, ...]]] = {}


def _remember_sackmann_rows(
    cache_key: tuple[str, str, int], rows: list[tuple[Any, ...]]
) -> None:
    db_key, cutoff, _ = cache_key
    for stale in [
        key for key in _SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE
        if key[0] == db_key and key[1] == cutoff
    ]:
        del _SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE[stale]
    while len(_SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE) >= SACKMANN_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES:
        _SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE.pop(next(iter(_SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE)))
    _SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE[cache_key] = rows


def _sackmann_aliases(name: str) -> set[str]:
    n = _norm_pid(name)
    if not n:
        return set()
    parts = [x for x in n.split() if x]
    a = {n}
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        first, last = parts[0], parts[-1]
        a.add(f"{last} {first[0]}")
        a.add(f"{last} {first}")
        a.add(f"{first[0]} {last}")
    return a


def _tennis_sackmann_features(repo: Repository, p1: str, p2: str, start_at: datetime) -> dict[str, float]:
    p1 = _sackmann_canonical_name(p1)
    p2 = _sackmann_canonical_name(p2)
    cutoff = start_at.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    window_start = (start_at - timedelta(days=5 * 365)).strftime("%Y%m%d")
    cutoff_ord = start_at.date().toordinal()
    db_key = str(getattr(repo, "path", ""))
    try:
        with repo.connection() as conn:
            conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sackmann_matches LIMIT 1")
            total = int(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sackmann_matches WHERE tourney_date < ? AND tourney_date >= ?",
                    (cutoff, window_start),
                ).fetchone()[0]
            )
    except Exception:
        return {}
    cache_key = (db_key, cutoff, total)
    rows = _SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE.get(cache_key)
    if rows is None:
        with repo.connection() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT tourney_date,surface,best_of,winner_name,loser_name,
                       w_svpt,w_1stWon,w_2ndWon,l_svpt,l_1stWon,l_2ndWon,
                       is_retirement,winner_rank,loser_rank
                FROM sackmann_matches
                WHERE tourney_date < ? AND tourney_date >= ?
                ORDER BY tourney_date, tourney_id, match_num
                """,
                (cutoff, window_start),
            ).fetchall()
        _remember_sackmann_rows(cache_key, rows)
    from collections import defaultdict

    # Bayesian priors and an exponential recency decay (half-life = 1 year).
    # A player's service/return rate is a small-sample estimate, so pull it
    # toward a population prior and let recent matches dominate old ones.
    SRV_PRIOR = 0.62
    RET_PRIOR = 0.38
    RETIRE_PRIOR = 0.04
    SRV_SHRINK = 200.0
    RET_SHRINK = 200.0
    RETIRE_SHRINK = 20.0

    def _st():
        return {
            "svc_pts": 0, "svc_won": 0, "ret_pts": 0, "ret_won": 0,
            "svc_w": 0.0, "svc_won_w": 0.0, "ret_w": 0.0, "ret_won_w": 0.0,
            "matches_365": 0, "wins_365": 0, "matches_30": 0,
            "matches_total": 0, "retirements": 0,
            "surf_matches": 0, "surf_wins": 0, "elo": 1500.0, "last_date": None,
            "rank": None, "last_surface": "", "last_best_of": 3, "elo_surface": {},
        }

    stats = defaultdict(_st)

    def i(v):
        try:
            if v is None or str(v).strip() == "":
                return 0
            return int(float(v))
        except Exception:
            return 0

    K=32.0
    for r in rows:
        d = _parse_result_date(str(r["tourney_date"]))
        if d is None or d >= start_at:
            continue
        age_days = max(0, cutoff_ord - d.date().toordinal())
        recent = age_days <= 365
        in_30 = age_days <= 30
        recency_weight = 2.0 ** (-age_days / 365.0)
        retired = i(r["is_retirement"]) == 1
        w = _norm_pid(str(r["winner_name"] or ""))
        l = _norm_pid(str(r["loser_name"] or ""))
        surface = str(r["surface"] or "").lower().strip()
        best_of = i(r["best_of"])
        wrank = i(r["winner_rank"]) or None
        lr_rank = i(r["loser_rank"]) or None
        for name, won, is_w, rank in ((w, 1, True, wrank), (l, 0, False, lr_rank)):
            if not name:
                continue
            st = stats[name]
            if rank is not None:
                st["rank"] = rank
            if surface:
                st["last_surface"] = surface
            if best_of in (3, 5):
                st["last_best_of"] = best_of
            st["matches_total"] += 1
            if in_30:
                st["matches_30"] += 1
            if recent:
                st["matches_365"] += 1
                st["wins_365"] += won
            if retired and not is_w:
                st["retirements"] += 1
            st["last_date"] = d
            if is_w:
                svpt=i(r["w_svpt"]); s1=i(r["w_1stWon"]); s2=i(r["w_2ndWon"])
                os1=i(r["l_1stWon"]); os2=i(r["l_2ndWon"]); ospt=i(r["l_svpt"])
            else:
                svpt=i(r["l_svpt"]); s1=i(r["l_1stWon"]); s2=i(r["l_2ndWon"])
                os1=i(r["w_1stWon"]); os2=i(r["w_2ndWon"]); ospt=i(r["w_svpt"])
            if svpt > 0:
                st["svc_pts"] += svpt
                st["svc_won"] += s1 + s2
                st["svc_w"] += recency_weight * svpt
                st["svc_won_w"] += recency_weight * (s1 + s2)
            if ospt > 0:
                st["ret_pts"] += ospt
                st["ret_won"] += max(ospt - os1 - os2, 0)
                st["ret_w"] += recency_weight * ospt
                st["ret_won_w"] += recency_weight * max(ospt - os1 - os2, 0)
        # simple pre-event Elo update from Sackmann history
        if w and l:
            rw, rl = stats[w]["elo"], stats[l]["elo"]
            ew = 1.0/(1.0+10**((rl-rw)/400.0))
            stats[w]["elo"] = rw + K*(1.0-ew)
            stats[l]["elo"] = rl + K*(0.0-ew)
            if surface:
                sw = stats[w]["elo_surface"].get(surface, 1500.0)
                sl = stats[l]["elo_surface"].get(surface, 1500.0)
                es = 1.0/(1.0+10**((sl-sw)/400.0))
                stats[w]["elo_surface"][surface] = sw + K*(1.0-es)
                stats[l]["elo_surface"][surface] = sl + K*(0.0-es)
    evt_surface = (
        (stats.get(p1) or {}).get("last_surface")
        or (stats.get(p2) or {}).get("last_surface")
        or ""
    )
    evt_best_of = int(
        (stats.get(p1) or {}).get("last_best_of")
        or (stats.get(p2) or {}).get("last_best_of")
        or 3
    )

    def surface_rate(name, surface):
        if not name or not surface: return 0.5
        wins=tot=0
        aliases=_sackmann_aliases(name)
        for r in rows:
            d=_parse_result_date(str(r["tourney_date"]))
            if d is None or d>=start_at: continue
            if (cutoff_ord-d.date().toordinal())>365*3: continue
            if str(r["surface"] or "").lower().strip()!=surface: continue
            w=_norm_pid(str(r["winner_name"] or "")); l=_norm_pid(str(r["loser_name"] or ""))
            if w in aliases: wins+=1; tot+=1
            elif l in aliases: tot+=1
        return (wins/tot) if tot>=3 else 0.5

    def get(name):
        st = stats.get(name)
        if not st:
            return {
                "srv_win": SRV_PRIOR, "ret_win": RET_PRIOR,
                "retire_risk": RETIRE_PRIOR, "matches_365": 0.0, "matches_30": 0.0,
                "win_rate_365": 0.5, "elo": 1500.0, "surface_win_rate": 0.5,
                "rank": None, "elo_surface": {},
            }
        srv = (
            (st["svc_won_w"] + SRV_PRIOR * SRV_SHRINK) / (st["svc_w"] + SRV_SHRINK)
            if st["svc_w"] > 0 else SRV_PRIOR
        )
        ret = (
            (st["ret_won_w"] + RET_PRIOR * RET_SHRINK) / (st["ret_w"] + RET_SHRINK)
            if st["ret_w"] > 0 else RET_PRIOR
        )
        retire_risk = (
            (st["retirements"] + RETIRE_PRIOR * RETIRE_SHRINK)
            / (st["matches_total"] + RETIRE_SHRINK)
        )
        m365 = st["matches_365"]
        return {
            "srv_win": srv,
            "ret_win": ret,
            "retire_risk": retire_risk,
            "matches_365": float(m365),
            "matches_30": float(st["matches_30"]),
            "win_rate_365": (st["wins_365"] / m365) if m365 else 0.5,
            "elo": float(st["elo"]),
            "surface_win_rate": surface_rate(name, evt_surface),
            "rank": st["rank"],
            "elo_surface": st["elo_surface"],
        }

    a, b = get(p1), get(p2)

    def rank_diff(mine, theirs):
        if mine is None or theirs is None:
            return 0.0
        # Lower rank number is better; + means the player is ranked higher.
        return math.log((float(theirs) + 10.0) / (float(mine) + 10.0))

    def surface_elo(player):
        return float(player["elo_surface"].get(evt_surface, 1500.0))

    return {
        "surface": evt_surface, "best_of": evt_best_of,
        "p1_srv_win": a["srv_win"], "p2_srv_win": b["srv_win"],
        "p1_ret_win": a["ret_win"], "p2_ret_win": b["ret_win"],
        "p1_retire_risk": a["retire_risk"], "p2_retire_risk": b["retire_risk"],
        "p1_matches_365": a["matches_365"], "p2_matches_365": b["matches_365"],
        "p1_matches_30": a["matches_30"], "p2_matches_30": b["matches_30"],
        "p1_win_rate_365": a["win_rate_365"], "p2_win_rate_365": b["win_rate_365"],
        "p1_surface_win_rate": a["surface_win_rate"], "p2_surface_win_rate": b["surface_win_rate"],
        "p1_elo_sackmann": a["elo"], "p2_elo_sackmann": b["elo"],
        "p1_rank": float(a["rank"]) if a["rank"] is not None else 300.0,
        "p2_rank": float(b["rank"]) if b["rank"] is not None else 300.0,
        "p1_rank_diff": rank_diff(a["rank"], b["rank"]),
        "p2_rank_diff": rank_diff(b["rank"], a["rank"]),
        "p1_elo_hard": a["elo_surface"].get("hard", 1500.0),
        "p2_elo_hard": b["elo_surface"].get("hard", 1500.0),
        "p1_elo_clay": a["elo_surface"].get("clay", 1500.0),
        "p2_elo_clay": b["elo_surface"].get("clay", 1500.0),
        "p1_elo_grass": a["elo_surface"].get("grass", 1500.0),
        "p2_elo_grass": b["elo_surface"].get("grass", 1500.0),
        "p1_surface_elo": surface_elo(a), "p2_surface_elo": surface_elo(b),
        "p1_elo_blend": 0.6 * surface_elo(a) + 0.4 * a["elo"],
        "p2_elo_blend": 0.6 * surface_elo(b) + 0.4 * b["elo"],
    }

def build_features(
    event: CanonicalEvent,
    repo: Repository,
    as_of: datetime | None = None,
    cached_results: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Build a numeric feature dict for an event.

    Uses only data observed before ``event.start_at`` and before ``as_of``
    when provided, preventing future leakage.
    """
    start_at = _to_dt(event.start_at)
    if start_at is None:
        return {}

    if as_of is not None:
        as_of_dt = _to_dt(as_of)
        if as_of_dt is not None:
            start_at = min(start_at, as_of_dt)

    participants = tuple(str(p) for p in (event.participant_ids or ()))
    p1 = _norm_pid(participants[0]) if len(participants) > 0 else ""
    p2 = _norm_pid(participants[1]) if len(participants) > 1 else ""

    with repo.connection() as conn:
        snap_rows = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT bookmaker, market, outcome, odds_decimal, observed_at
            FROM odds_snapshots
            WHERE event_uid = ? AND is_live = 0
            ORDER BY observed_at, id
            """,
            (str(event.event_uid),),
        ).fetchall()

    pre_start = []
    for row in snap_rows:
        observed_at = _to_dt(row["observed_at"])
        if observed_at is None or observed_at >= start_at:
            continue
        pre_start.append(row)

    latest_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str, str], Any] = {}
    for row in pre_start:
        key = (
            str(row["bookmaker"]),
            str(row["market"]),
            str(row["outcome"]),
        )
        latest_by_key[key] = row

    p1_prices = [
        _safe_float(row["odds_decimal"])
        for row in latest_by_key.values()
        if str(row["outcome"]) == "p1"
        and str(row["market"]) in {"match_winner", "moneyline", "winner"}
    ]
    p2_prices = [
        _safe_float(row["odds_decimal"])
        for row in latest_by_key.values()
        if str(row["outcome"]) == "p2"
        and str(row["market"]) in {"match_winner", "moneyline", "winner"}
    ]

    p1_best = max(p1_prices) if p1_prices else 0.0
    p2_best = max(p2_prices) if p2_prices else 0.0
    p1_implied = (1.0 / p1_best) if p1_best > 1.0 else 0.0
    p2_implied = (1.0 / p2_best) if p2_best > 1.0 else 0.0
    # Consensus only makes sense when both sides of the market are quoted.
    # With a single leg, the previous version returned 1.0 for the quoted
    # side, which the model learned as "guaranteed win".
    if p1_implied > 0.0 and p2_implied > 0.0:
        p1_consensus = p1_implied / (p1_implied + p2_implied)
    else:
        p1_consensus = 0.5

    results = cached_results if cached_results is not None else repo.results()
    event_day = start_at.date()
    history: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in results:
        row_dt = _parse_result_date(row.get("event_date"))
        if row_dt is None or row_dt.date() >= event_day:
            continue
        history.append(row)

    def _form(pid: str) -> float:
        wins = 0
        total = 0
        for row in history:
            pa = _norm_pid(str(row.get("participant_a") or ""))
            pb = _norm_pid(str(row.get("participant_b") or ""))
            side = _winner_from_score(str(row.get("score") or ""))
            if side is None:
                continue
            if pid and pid == pa:
                total += 1
                if side == "left":
                    wins += 1
            elif pid and pid == pb:
                total += 1
                if side == "right":
                    wins += 1
        return (wins / total) if total else 0.5

    def _last_play_day(pid: str) -> datetime | None:
        days: list[datetime] = []
        for row in history:
            pa = _norm_pid(str(row.get("participant_a") or ""))
            pb = _norm_pid(str(row.get("participant_b") or ""))
            if pid and pid in {pa, pb}:
                dt = _parse_result_date(row.get("event_date"))
                if dt is not None:
                    days.append(dt)
        return max(days) if days else None

    def _rest_days(pid: str) -> float:
        last_dt = _last_play_day(pid)
        if last_dt is None:
            return 30.0
        delta = start_at.date().toordinal() - last_dt.date().toordinal()
        return float(max(delta, 0))

    h2h_p1_wins = 0
    h2h_total = 0
    for row in history:
        pa = _norm_pid(str(row.get("participant_a") or ""))
        pb = _norm_pid(str(row.get("participant_b") or ""))
        if {pa, pb} != {p1, p2}:
            continue
        side = _winner_from_score(str(row.get("score") or ""))
        if side is None:
            continue
        h2h_total += 1
        winner = pa if side == "left" else pb
        if winner == p1:
            h2h_p1_wins += 1

    feats = {
        "p1_form": float(_form(p1)),
        "p2_form": float(_form(p2)),
        "p1_rest_days": float(_rest_days(p1)),
        "p2_rest_days": float(_rest_days(p2)),
        "surface": 0.0,
        "patch": 0.0,
        "map": 0.0,
        "h2h_p1": float(h2h_p1_wins / h2h_total) if h2h_total else 0.5,
        "market_p1_consensus": float(p1_consensus),
        "coverage_count": float(len({str(r["bookmaker"]) for r in pre_start})),
    }
    if str(event.sport).lower() == "tennis":
        tennis_feats = _tennis_sackmann_features(repo, p1, p2, start_at)
        surface_name = tennis_feats.pop("surface", "")
        feats.update(tennis_feats)
        feats["surface_name"] = str(surface_name or "")
    return feats
