from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

from betdash.app.tray import TrayController, _status_text
from betdash.config import Settings


def _settings(tmp_path):
    return Settings(db_path=str(tmp_path / "t.sqlite"), checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ck"))


def test_tray_start_stop_open(tmp_path):
    tc = TrayController(
        settings=_settings(tmp_path),
        dashboard_command=("python", "-c", "import time; time.sleep(5)"),
        workdir=str(tmp_path),
    )
    with patch("betdash.app.tray.webbrowser.open") as open_browser, patch(
        "betdash.app.tray.subprocess.Popen"
    ) as popen:
        proc = MagicMock()
        proc.poll.return_value = None
        popen.return_value = proc
        tc.start_dashboard()
        popen.assert_called_once()
        assert popen.call_args.kwargs.get("cwd") == str(tmp_path)
        tc.open_browser()
        open_browser.assert_called_once_with(tc.dashboard_url)
        status = tc.status()
        assert status["dashboard_running"] is True
        tc.stop_dashboard()
        proc.terminate.assert_called_once()


def test_tray_does_not_start_workers_in_process(tmp_path):
    tc = TrayController(settings=_settings(tmp_path), dashboard_command=("python", "-V"))
    with patch("betdash.app.tray.subprocess.Popen") as popen, patch(
        "betdash.app.dashboard.StreamlitRuntime.start_workers"
    ) as start_workers:
        proc = MagicMock()
        proc.poll.return_value = None
        popen.return_value = proc
        tc.start_dashboard()
        start_workers.assert_not_called()


def test_status_text_reflects_running_state():
    base = {"adapters": [{"status": "ok"}, {"status": "degraded"}], "training": {"last_run_id": "r1"}}
    assert "RUNNING" in _status_text({**base, "dashboard_running": True})
    assert "STOPPED" in _status_text({**base, "dashboard_running": False})


def test_build_icon_image_changes_by_state(tmp_path):
    tc = TrayController(settings=_settings(tmp_path))
    stopped = tc._build_icon_image(running=False)
    running = tc._build_icon_image(running=True)
    assert stopped.tobytes() != running.tobytes()

FILE: tests/backtest/test_engine.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.backtest.engine import BacktestEngine
from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.results.ingest import ResultRow


START = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
END = datetime(2026, 1, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
EVENT_START = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
CLOSE = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 17, 55, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


class ConstantModel:
    def fit(self, rows):
        return self

    def predict_prob(self, row) -> float:
        return 0.55


def seed_repo(tmp_path, *, duplicate_close: bool = False) -> Repository:
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("p1", "p2"),
        start_at=EVENT_START,
        mapping_confidence=0.99,
    )
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    # market_close_at lives in events table; set it for CLV.
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO events(event_uid, sport, league, participant_ids, start_at, market_close_at, mapping_confidence)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(event_uid) DO UPDATE SET market_close_at=excluded.market_close_at
            """,
            ("e1", "tennis", "ATP", '["p1","p2"]', EVENT_START.isoformat(), CLOSE.isoformat(), 0.99),
        )

    snaps = [
        # Decision-time snapshots, two books, both outcomes
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, T0, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, T0, "s2", "v1"),
        # Closing snapshots at/near market close
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 1.95, CLOSE, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.05, CLOSE, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.85, CLOSE, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.15, CLOSE, "s2", "v1"),
    ]
    if duplicate_close:
        snaps.extend([
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 1.95, CLOSE, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.05, CLOSE, "s1", "v1"),
        ])
    repo.save_snapshots(snaps)
    repo.save_result("e1", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="2026-01-10", score="2-0", league="ATP"))
    return repo


def test_actual_for_row_handles_empty_score_without_nameerror(tmp_path):
    engine = BacktestEngine(Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite")), ConstantModel())
    row = {"market": "match_winner", "outcome": "p1", "participant_ids": ("p1", "p2")}
    result = {"participant_a": "p1", "participant_b": "p2", "score": ""}
    assert engine._actual_for_row(row, result) == 1


def test_signal_uses_only_snapshots_before_decision_time(tmp_path):
    repo = seed_repo(tmp_path)
    engine = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel())
    report = engine.run(START, END)
    assert all(p.observed_at < p.event_start_at for p in report.predictions)


def test_duplicate_snapshot_counted_once_in_clv(tmp_path):
    repo = seed_repo(tmp_path, duplicate_close=True)
    engine = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel())
    report = engine.run_with_duplicates(START, END, duplicated=True)
    assert report.clv_sample_count == 1


def test_missing_close_snapshot_excludes_clv_but_keeps_signal(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent("e1", "tennis", "ATP", ("p1", "p2"), EVENT_START, 0.99)
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    # no market_close_at / no close snapshots
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO events(event_uid, sport, league, participant_ids, start_at, market_close_at, mapping_confidence) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            ("e1", "tennis", "ATP", '["p1","p2"]', EVENT_START.isoformat(), None, 0.99),
        )
    repo.save_snapshots([
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, T0, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, T0, "s2", "v1"),
    ])
    repo.save_result("e1", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="2026-01-10", score="2-0", league="ATP"))
    report = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel()).run(START, END)
    assert len(report.predictions) >= 1
    assert all(p.clv is None for p in report.predictions)
    assert report.clv_sample_count == 0
    assert all(p.event_start_at == EVENT_START for p in report.predictions)


def test_signal_requires_two_book_coverage(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent("e1", "tennis", "ATP", ("p1", "p2"), EVENT_START, 0.99)
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    repo.save_snapshots([
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        # second book missing p1 -> coverage for p1 < 2
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, T0, "s2", "v1"),
    ])
    repo.save_result("e1", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="2026-01-10", score="2-0", league="ATP"))
    report = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel()).run(START, END)
    assert all(p.outcome != "p1" for p in report.predictions)


def test_actual_ambiguous_market_returns_none_not_guess(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent("e1", "tennis", "ATP", ("p1", "p2"), EVENT_START, 0.99)
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    repo.save_snapshots([
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "total_over_2.5", "over", 1.9, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "total_over_2.5", "under", 1.9, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "total_over_2.5", "over", 1.95, T0, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "total_over_2.5", "under", 1.85, T0, "s2", "v1"),
    ])
    repo.save_result("e1", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="2026-01-10", score="2-0", league="ATP"))
    report = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel()).run(START, END)
    # ambiguous/non-winner market: do not guess actual
    assert report.predictions == []


def test_clv_uses_persisted_canonical_market_close(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent("e1", "tennis", "ATP", ("p1", "p2"), EVENT_START, 0.99)
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    repo.set_market_close_at("e1", CLOSE)

    # Real persistence path: only canonical_events + snapshots/results persisted through repo.
    snaps = [
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, T0, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, T0, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, T0, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 1.95, CLOSE, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.05, CLOSE, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.85, CLOSE, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.15, CLOSE, "s2", "v1"),
    ]
    repo.save_snapshots(snaps)
    repo.save_result("e1", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="2026-01-10", score="2-0", league="ATP"))

    # Ensure no events.market_close_at row is required.
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE event_uid = ?", ("e1",))

    report = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel()).run(START, END)
    assert report.clv_sample_count == 1
    assert any(p.clv is not None for p in report.predictions)


def test_backtest_run_has_no_sport_argument(tmp_path):
    repo = seed_repo(tmp_path)
    report = BacktestEngine(repo, ConstantModel()).run(START, END)
    assert report.predictions




FILE: tests/backtest/test_metrics.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.backtest.engine import BacktestReport, PredictionRecord
from betdash.backtest import metrics


NOW = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
START = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def test_metrics_all_returns_required_keys():
    pred = PredictionRecord(
        event_uid="e1",
        market="match_winner",
        outcome="p1",
        odds_decimal=2.0,
        model_prob=0.6,
        observed_at=NOW,
        event_start_at=START,
        actual=1,
        clv=0.05,
    )
    report = BacktestReport(predictions=[pred], clv_sample_count=1, signals=[])
    result = metrics.all(report)
    for key in ["brier", "log_loss", "clv", "roi", "hit_rate", "max_drawdown"]:
        assert key in result

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from betdash.data.sackmann import ingest_sackmann_matches
from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.models.features import build_features
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent

HEADER = (
    "tourney_id,tourney_name,surface,draw_size,tourney_level,tourney_date,match_num,"
    "winner_id,winner_name,loser_id,loser_name,score,best_of,round,minutes,"
    "w_ace,w_df,w_svpt,w_1stIn,w_1stWon,w_2ndWon,w_SvGms,w_bpSaved,w_bpFaced,"
    "l_ace,l_df,l_svpt,l_1stIn,l_1stWon,l_2ndWon,l_SvGms,l_bpSaved,l_bpFaced"
)


def _row(tourney_id: str, winner: str, loser: str) -> str:
    return (
        f"{tourney_id},Old Open,Hard,32,A,20230101,1,100,{winner},200,{loser},"
        "6-4 6-4,3,R32,90,10,2,60,40,30,10,10,2,3,2,3,55,35,20,8,9,1,4"
    )


def _event(uid: str, p1: str, p2: str) -> CanonicalEvent:
    return CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid=uid,
        sport="tennis",
        league="Test",
        participant_ids=(f"name:{p1}", f"name:{p2}"),
        start_at=datetime(2023, 12, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )


def _ingest(repo: Repository, path: Path, rows: list[str]) -> None:
    csv_path = path / f"{repo.path.replace('/', '_')}.csv"
    csv_path.write_text(f"{HEADER}\n" + "\n".join(rows) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    ingest_sackmann_matches(repo, [csv_path], tour="atp")


def test_sackmann_history_cache_is_bounded_across_cutoffs():
    from betdash.models import features

    db = "/tmp/bounded.db"
    features._SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE.clear()
    for i in range(features.SACKMANN_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES + 4):
        features._SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE[(db, f"202301{i:02d}", i)] = [("old",)]

    newest_key = (db, "20991231", 999)
    features._remember_sackmann_rows(newest_key, [("new",)])

    assert len(features._SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE) <= features.SACKMANN_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
    assert features._SACKMANN_ROWS_CACHE[newest_key] == [("new",)]


def test_sackmann_history_cache_is_isolated_between_repositories(tmp_path: Path):
    repo_a = Repository(str(tmp_path / "a.db"))
    _ingest(repo_a, tmp_path, [_row("2023-001", "Alice Smith", "Bob Jones")])
    first = build_features(_event("e-a", "Alice Smith", "Bob Jones"), repo_a)

    repo_b = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.db"))
    _ingest(repo_b, tmp_path, [_row("2023-002", "Carol White", "Dan Brown")])
    second = build_features(_event("e-b", "Carol White", "Dan Brown"), repo_b)

    assert first["p1_matches_365"] == 1.0
    assert second["p1_matches_365"] == 1.0


def test_sackmann_history_cache_sees_new_matches_in_same_repository(tmp_path: Path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "c.db"))
    _ingest(repo, tmp_path, [_row("2023-003", "Alice Smith", "Bob Jones")])
    build_features(_event("e-c", "Alice Smith", "Bob Jones"), repo)

    _ingest(repo, tmp_path, [_row("2023-004", "Alice Smith", "Dan Brown")])
    features = build_features(_event("e-c", "Alice Smith", "Bob Jones"), repo)

    assert features["p1_matches_365"] == 2.0

from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3

from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.data.sackmann import ingest_sackmann_matches


def test_ingest_sackmann_matches_creates_table_and_rows(tmp_path: Path):
    db = tmp_path / "test.db"
    repo = Repository(str(db))

    csv_path = tmp_path / "atp_matches_2024.csv"
    csv_path.write_text(
        "tourney_id,tourney_name,surface,draw_size,tourney_level,tourney_date,match_num,winner_id,winner_name,loser_id,loser_name,score,best_of,round,minutes,w_ace,w_df,w_svpt,w_1stIn,w_1stWon,w_2ndWon,w_SvGms,w_bpSaved,w_bpFaced,l_ace,l_df,l_svpt,l_1stIn,l_1stWon,l_2ndWon,l_SvGms,l_bpSaved,l_bpFaced\n"
        "2024-001,Test Open,Hard,32,A,20240101,1,100,Player A,200,Player B,6-4 6-3,3,R32,90,5,2,60,40,30,10,10,2,3,3,4,55,35,20,8,9,1,4\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    n = ingest_sackmann_matches(repo, [csv_path], tour="atp")
    assert n == 1

    conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM sackmann_matches").fetchone()
    assert row["tour"] == "atp"
    assert row["winner_name"] == "Player A"
    assert row["loser_name"] == "Player B"
    assert row["surface"] == "Hard"
    assert row["w_ace"] == 5
    assert row["is_retirement"] == 0
    conn.close()


def test_reingest_backfills_missing_rank_columns(tmp_path: Path):
    header = (
        "tourney_id,tourney_name,surface,draw_size,tourney_level,tourney_date,match_num,"
        "winner_id,winner_name,loser_id,loser_name,score,best_of,round,minutes,"
        "w_ace,w_df,w_svpt,w_1stIn,w_1stWon,w_2ndWon,w_SvGms,w_bpSaved,w_bpFaced,"
        "l_ace,l_df,l_svpt,l_1stIn,l_1stWon,l_2ndWon,l_SvGms,l_bpSaved,l_bpFaced,"
        "is_retirement,winner_rank,winner_rank_points,loser_rank,loser_rank_points"
    )
    row = (
        "legacy,Open,Hard,32,A,20240101,1,1,Player A,2,Player B,6-4 6-4,3,R32,90,"
        "5,1,60,39,28,12,10,4,8,4,1,60,39,19,9,9,3,7,0,7,1000,33,800"
    )
    db = tmp_path / "legacy.db"
    repo = Repository(str(db))
    csv_path = tmp_path / "atp.csv"
    csv_path.write_text(header + "\n" + row + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    assert ingest_sackmann_matches(repo, [csv_path], tour="atp") == 1

    conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute("SELECT winner_rank, loser_rank FROM sackmann_matches").fetchone()
    assert row["winner_rank"] == 7
    assert row["loser_rank"] == 33
    conn.close()




FILE: tests/data/test_sackmann_recency_retirement.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from betdash.data.sackmann import ingest_sackmann_matches
from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.models.features import build_features
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent

HEADER = (
    "tourney_id,tourney_name,surface,draw_size,tourney_level,tourney_date,match_num,"
    "winner_id,winner_name,loser_id,loser_name,score,best_of,round,minutes,"
    "w_ace,w_df,w_svpt,w_1stIn,w_1stWon,w_2ndWon,w_SvGms,w_bpSaved,w_bpFaced,"
    "l_ace,l_df,l_svpt,l_1stIn,l_1stWon,l_2ndWon,l_SvGms,l_bpSaved,l_bpFaced,"
    "is_retirement,winner_rank,winner_rank_points,loser_rank,loser_rank_points"
)


def _row(
    tourney_id: str,
    date: str,
    winner: str,
    loser: str,
    w_svpt: int,
    w_won: int,
    l_svpt: int,
    l_won: int,
    retirement: int = 0,
    w_rank: str = "",
    l_rank: str = "",
    surface: str = "Hard",
) -> str:
    w1, w2 = int(w_won * 0.7), w_won - int(w_won * 0.7)
    l1, l2 = int(l_won * 0.7), l_won - int(l_won * 0.7)
    return (
        f"{tourney_id},Open,{surface},32,A,{date},1,1,{winner},2,{loser},"
        f"{'6-4 3-2 RET' if retirement else '6-4 6-4'},3,R32,90,5,1,{w_svpt},{int(w_svpt * 0.65)},{w1},{w2},10,4,8,"
        f"4,1,{l_svpt},{int(l_svpt * 0.65)},{l1},{l2},9,3,7,{retirement},"
        f"{w_rank},{w_rank and '1000'},{l_rank},{l_rank and '1000'}"
    )


def _event(p1: str, p2: str) -> CanonicalEvent:
    return CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="Test",
        participant_ids=(f"name:{p1}", f"name:{p2}"),
        start_at=datetime(2023, 12, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )


def _ingest(tmp_path: Path, rows: list[str]) -> Repository:
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "test.db"))
    csv_path = tmp_path / "atp.csv"
    csv_path.write_text(HEADER + "\n" + "\n".join(rows) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert ingest_sackmann_matches(repo, [csv_path], tour="atp") == len(rows)
    return repo


def test_recent_serve_results_are_weighted_more_than_old_ones(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = _ingest(
        tmp_path,
        [
            _row("old", "20200101", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 54, 60, 30),
            _row("recent", "20231101", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 18, 60, 30),
        ],
    )

    features = build_features(_event("Player A", "Player B"), repo)

    # Raw average would be 0.60; recency weighting plus shrinkage must pull it down.
    assert 0.5 < features["p1_srv_win"] < 0.58
    assert features["p1_matches_30"] == 1.0


def test_retirement_history_raises_player_retire_risk(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = _ingest(
        tmp_path,
        [
            _row("r1", "20230501", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 40, 60, 28),
            _row("r2", "20230601", "Player B", "Player A", 60, 38, 45, 20, retirement=1),
        ],
    )

    features = build_features(_event("Player A", "Player B"), repo)

    assert features["p1_retire_risk"] > 0.05
    assert features["p2_retire_risk"] <= 0.05


def test_rank_features_use_pre_event_ranks(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = _ingest(
        tmp_path,
        [
            _row("r1", "20230501", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 40, 60, 28, w_rank="5", l_rank="50"),
            _row("r2", "20230601", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 42, 60, 27, w_rank="4", l_rank="48"),
        ],
    )

    features = build_features(_event("Player A", "Player B"), repo)

    assert features["p1_rank"] == 4.0
    assert features["p2_rank"] == 48.0
    assert features["p1_rank_diff"] > 0.0
    assert features["p2_rank_diff"] < 0.0


def test_surface_elo_is_tracked_per_surface(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    repo = _ingest(
        tmp_path,
        [
            _row("h1", "20230101", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 45, 60, 25, surface="Hard"),
            _row("h2", "20230201", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 44, 60, 26, surface="Hard"),
            _row("c1", "20230301", "Player B", "Player A", 60, 43, 60, 27, surface="Clay"),
            _row("h3", "20231101", "Player A", "Player B", 60, 46, 60, 24, surface="Hard"),
        ],
    )

    features = build_features(_event("Player A", "Player B"), repo)

    assert features["p1_elo_hard"] > features["p2_elo_hard"]
    assert features["p1_elo_clay"] < features["p2_elo_clay"]
    assert features["p1_surface_elo"] > features["p2_surface_elo"]

FILE: tests/db/test_prediction_id_migration.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.backtest.clv import backfill_clv
from betdash.db.repository import Repository


LEGACY_PREDICTIONS = """
CREATE TABLE predictions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    model_run_id TEXT,
    event_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    market TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    line REAL,
    model_prob REAL NOT NULL,
    odds_decimal REAL,
    bookmaker TEXT,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision_observed_at TEXT,
    event_start_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
    closing_odds REAL,
    clv REAL,
    actual_outcome INTEGER,
    settled_at TEXT
)
"""


def test_legacy_predictions_get_ids_and_can_receive_clv(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "legacy.sqlite"))
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.execute("DROP TABLE predictions")
        conn.execute(LEGACY_PREDICTIONS)
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO predictions(
                model_run_id, event_uid, market, outcome, model_prob,
                odds_decimal, observed_at, event_start_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                "run-1",
                "event-1",
                "match_winner",
                "p1",
                0.55,
                2.10,
                datetime(2026, 1, 1, 9, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            ),
        )
        conn.commit()

    # Repository._connect() runs schema migrations and must backfill the id.
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT prediction_id FROM predictions").fetchone()
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO closing_lines(event_uid, market, line, outcome, odds_closing, bookmaker, captured_at)
            VALUES ('event-1', 'match_winner', NULL, 'p1', 2.00, 'b1', '2026-01-01T09:55:00+00:00')
            """
        )
        conn.commit()

    assert row["prediction_id"]
    assert backfill_clv(repo) == 1
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        filled = conn.execute("SELECT closing_odds, clv FROM predictions").fetchone()
    assert float(filled["closing_odds"]) == 2.0
    assert float(filled["clv"]) > 0

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from betdash.db.repository import (
    AdapterHealth,
    Repository,
    Snapshot,
    init_db,
)

NOW = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

EXPECTED_TABLES = {
    "events",
    "participants",
    "event_aliases",
    "market_types",
    "odds_snapshots",
    "results",
    "feature_values",
    "predictions",
    "model_runs",
    "adapter_health",
}


def make_snapshot(**overrides) -> Snapshot:
    values = {
        "event_uid": "e1",
        "bookmaker": "pari",
        "market": "match_winner",
        "outcome": "p1",
        "odds_decimal": 2.0,
        "observed_at": NOW,
        "source_event_id": "p1",
        "adapter_version": "1",
        "is_live": False,
    }
    values.update(overrides)
    return Snapshot(**values)


def test_init_db_creates_tables(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"
    init_db(str(db))

    assert db.exists()
    with sqlite3.connect(db) as conn:
        names = {
            row[0]
            for row in conn.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
            )
        }
    assert EXPECTED_TABLES <= names


def test_init_db_enables_wal(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"
    init_db(str(db))

    with sqlite3.connect(db) as conn:
        mode = conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0]

    assert mode.lower() == "wal"


def test_init_db_is_idempotent(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"
    init_db(str(db))
    init_db(str(db))

    with sqlite3.connect(db) as conn:
        count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'odds_snapshots'"
        ).fetchone()[0]
    assert count == 1


def test_save_snapshots_dedupes_same_key(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    s = Snapshot(
        event_uid="e1",
        bookmaker="pari",
        market="match_winner",
        outcome="p1",
        odds_decimal=2.0,
        observed_at=NOW,
        source_event_id="p1",
        adapter_version="1",
        is_live=False,
    )

    assert repo.save_snapshots([s, s]) == 1
    assert len(repo.last_snapshots("e1")) == 1


def test_save_snapshots_never_updates_existing_rows(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    repo.save_snapshots([make_snapshot(odds_decimal=2.0)])

    assert repo.save_snapshots([make_snapshot(odds_decimal=3.5)]) == 0
    [stored] = repo.last_snapshots("e1")
    assert stored.odds_decimal == 2.0


def test_last_snapshots_returns_latest_row_per_selection(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    later = NOW + timedelta(seconds=90)
    repo.save_snapshots(
        [
            make_snapshot(observed_at=NOW, odds_decimal=2.0),
            make_snapshot(observed_at=later, odds_decimal=2.1),
            make_snapshot(outcome="p2", odds_decimal=1.8),
        ]
    )

    latest = {snap.outcome: snap for snap in repo.last_snapshots("e1")}

    assert latest["p1"].odds_decimal == 2.1
    assert latest["p1"].observed_at == later
    assert latest["p2"].odds_decimal == 1.8
    assert len(repo.last_snapshots("other")) == 0


def test_snapshot_round_trip_preserves_fields(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    snapshot = make_snapshot(source_url="https://example.test/line", is_live=True)
    repo.save_snapshots([snapshot])

    [stored] = repo.last_snapshots("e1")
    assert stored == snapshot


def test_adapter_health_round_trip(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    health = AdapterHealth(
        bookmaker="pari",
        status="ok",
        last_success=NOW,
        error_count=0,
        adapter_version="1",
    )
    repo.upsert_adapter_health(health)

    assert repo.adapter_health() == [health]


def test_adapter_health_upsert_keeps_one_row_per_bookmaker(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    repo.upsert_adapter_health(
        AdapterHealth("pari", "degraded", None, 3, "1")
    )
    repo.upsert_adapter_health(
        AdapterHealth("pari", "ok", NOW, 0, "1")
    )
    repo.upsert_adapter_health(
        AdapterHealth("fonbet", "ok", NOW, 0, "2")
    )

    health = {row.bookmaker: row for row in repo.adapter_health()}
    assert set(health) == {"pari", "fonbet"}
    assert health["pari"].status == "ok"
    assert health["pari"].error_count == 0
    assert health["fonbet"].adapter_version == "2"

import inspect
from pathlib import Path

import betdash.db.repository as repository_module
from betdash.db.repository import Repository


def test_repository_exposes_public_connection_context_manager(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "repo.sqlite"))

    with repo.connection() as conn:
        value = conn.execute("SELECT 1").fetchone()[0]

    assert value == 1


def test_legacy_connect_still_works_as_context_manager(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "legacy.sqlite"))

    with repo._connect() as conn:
        value = conn.execute("SELECT 1").fetchone()[0]

    assert value == 1


def test_connection_is_decorated_and_private_calls_are_migrated():
    source = inspect.getsource(Repository.connection)
    assert "@contextmanager" in source

    repository_path = Path(repository_module.__file__).resolve()
    root = repository_path.parent.parent
    offenders = [
        str(path.relative_to(root))
        for path in root.rglob("*.py")
        if path.resolve() != repository_path and "._connect()" in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ]
    assert offenders == []

from betdash.db.repository import Repository


def test_connection_runs_schema_checks_once_per_database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "ready.db"))
    calls = {"odds": 0}

    original = Repository._ensure_odds_snapshot_columns

    def counted(self, connection):
        calls["odds"] += 1
        original(connection)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Repository, "_ensure_odds_snapshot_columns", counted)

    with repo.connection():
        pass
    with repo.connection():
        pass

    assert calls["odds"] == 1


def test_connection_marks_ready_even_when_first_use_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "writing.db"))
    calls = {"odds": 0}
    original = Repository._ensure_odds_snapshot_columns

    def counted(self, connection):
        calls["odds"] += 1
        original(connection)

    monkeypatch.setattr(Repository, "_ensure_odds_snapshot_columns", counted)

    with repo.connection() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO bankroll(id,amount,updated_at) VALUES (1,100,'x')"
        )
    with repo.connection():
        pass

    assert calls["odds"] == 1

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.db.repository import Repository


def _row(run_id: str, event_uid: str, prob: float) -> dict:
    now = datetime(2026, 11, 28, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return {
        "model_run_id": run_id,
        "event_uid": event_uid,
        "market": "match_winner",
        "outcome": "p1",
        "model_prob": prob,
        "odds_decimal": 2.0,
        "observed_at": now,
        "event_start_at": now,
    }


def test_save_predictions_keeps_rows_from_other_runs(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "predictions.sqlite"))
    repo.save_predictions([_row("run-old", "e-old", 0.55)])
    repo.save_predictions([_row("run-new", "e-new", 0.65)])

    with repo._connect() as conn:
        runs = [r[0] for r in conn.execute("SELECT DISTINCT model_run_id FROM predictions")]

    assert set(runs) == {"run-old", "run-new"}

import sqlite3

from betdash.db.repository import Repository


def test_score_distribution_storage_round_trip(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "test.db"))
    row = {
        "event_uid": "e1",
        "model_run_id": "run-1",
        "provider": "empirical",
        "observed_at": "2026-11-28T10:00:00Z",
        "distribution": {"6-4 6-4": 0.7, "6-4 5-7 6-4": 0.3},
        "p1_prob": 0.62,
    }

    repo.save_score_distribution(row)

    rows = repo.score_distributions(event_uid="e1", model_run_id="run-1")
    assert len(rows) == 1
    assert rows[0]["provider"] == "empirical"
    assert rows[0]["distribution"] == row["distribution"]
    assert rows[0]["p1_prob"] == 0.62

        "model_run_id": "run-2",
        "provider": "markov",

        "distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.6, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.4},
        "p1_prob": 0.6,
    }

    repo.save_score_distribution(row)
    loaded = repo.score_distributions(event_uid="e2")

    assert loaded[0]["distribution"] == row["distribution"]

        "event_uid",
        "model_run_id",
        "provider",
        "observed_at",
        "distribution_json",

from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot

def test_snapshot_history_returns_chronological(tmp_path):

            event_uid="e1", bookmaker="bk1", market="match_winner", outcome="p1",

FILE: tests/db/test_tennis_migration.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from betdash.db.repository import Repository, init_db
from betdash.db.tennis_migration import archive_and_purge_non_tennis


def _db(path):
    init_db(str(path))
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
    conn.executescript(
        """
        CREATE TABLE sackmann_matches (
            tour TEXT,
            tourney_id TEXT,
            match_num INTEGER,
            winner_id INTEGER,
            loser_id INTEGER,
            PRIMARY KEY (tour, tourney_id, match_num, winner_id, loser_id)
        );
        """
    )
    conn.executemany(
        """INSERT INTO canonical_events
           (event_uid, sport, league, participant_ids, start_at, mapping_confidence)
           VALUES (?, ?, 'Test', '[]', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 1.0)""",
        [("tennis-1", "tennis"), ("basket-1", "basketball")],
    )
    conn.executemany(
        """INSERT INTO odds_snapshots
           (event_uid, bookmaker, market, outcome, odds_decimal, observed_at, adapter_version)
           VALUES (?, ?, 'match_winner', 'p1', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 'test')""",
        [
            ("tennis-1", "pari", 2.0),
            ("basket-1", "pari", 2.1),
            ("orphan-1", "fonbet", 3.0),
        ],
    )
    conn.executemany(
        """INSERT INTO predictions
           (prediction_id, event_uid, market, outcome, model_prob, odds_decimal, observed_at)
           VALUES (?, ?, 'match_winner', 'p1', 0.5, ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')""",
        [("p-tennis", "tennis-1", 2.0), ("p-basket", "basket-1", 2.1)],
    )
    conn.executemany(
        """INSERT INTO closing_lines
           (event_uid, market, outcome, odds_closing, captured_at)
           VALUES (?, 'match_winner', 'p1', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')""",
        [("tennis-1", 1.9), ("basket-1", 2.0)],
    )
    conn.executemany(
        """INSERT INTO closing_lines_book
           (event_uid, market, outcome, bookmaker, odds_closing, captured_at)
           VALUES (?, 'match_winner', 'p1', 'pari', ?, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')""",
        [("tennis-1", 1.9), ("basket-1", 2.0)],
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches(tour, tourney_id, match_num, winner_id, loser_id) VALUES ('atp', 'x', 1, 1, 2)"
    )
    conn.commit()
    return conn


def _sports(path):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:
        return {row[0] for row in conn.execute("SELECT DISTINCT sport FROM canonical_events")}
    finally:
        conn.close()


def _orphans(path):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:
        return conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM odds_snapshots s LEFT JOIN canonical_events e ON e.event_uid = s.event_uid WHERE e.event_uid IS NULL"
        ).fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()


def test_archive_and_purge_removes_orphan_snapshots(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "work.sqlite"
    archive = tmp_path / "archive.sqlite"
    conn = _db(db)
    conn.close()

    report = archive_and_purge_non_tennis(Repository(str(db)), archive)

    assert report["canonical_events"]["basketball"] == 1
    assert _sports(db) == {"tennis"}
    assert _orphans(db) == 0
    assert _orphans(archive) == 1
    ac = sqlite3.connect(archive)
    try:
        assert ac.execute("SELECT sport FROM canonical_events").fetchall() == [("basketball",)]
        assert ac.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM odds_snapshots").fetchone()[0] == 2
        assert ac.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM predictions").fetchone()[0] == 1
        assert ac.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sackmann_matches").fetchone()[0] == 0
    finally:
        ac.close()
    wc = sqlite3.connect(db)
    try:
        assert wc.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM odds_snapshots").fetchone()[0] == 1
        assert wc.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sackmann_matches").fetchone()[0] == 1
    finally:
        wc.close()


def test_archive_and_purge_handles_null_event_uid(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "work.sqlite"
    archive = tmp_path / "archive.sqlite"
    conn = _db(db)
    conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO canonical_events
           (event_uid, sport, league, participant_ids, start_at, mapping_confidence)
           VALUES (NULL, 'basketball', 'Test', '[]', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 1.0)"""
    )
    conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO events
           (event_uid, sport, league, participant_ids, start_at, mapping_confidence)
           VALUES (NULL, 'basketball', 'Test', '[]', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', 1.0)"""
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    archive_and_purge_non_tennis(Repository(str(db)), archive)

    assert _sports(db) == {"tennis"}
    assert _orphans(db) == 0
    ac = sqlite3.connect(archive)
    try:
        assert ac.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM canonical_events WHERE sport = 'basketball'").fetchone()[0] == 2
        assert ac.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_uid IS NULL"
        ).fetchone()[0] == 1
    finally:
        ac.close()


def test_main_prepares_wal_and_has_module_entrypoint():
    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "src" / "betdash" / "db" / "tennis_migration.py"
    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'if __name__ == "__main__":' in text
    assert "PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)" in text
    assert "PRAGMA busy_timeout" in text


def test_main_validates_checkpoint_before_purge(tmp_path):
    from betdash.db.tennis_migration import main

    db = tmp_path / "db.sqlite"
    conn = _db(db)
    conn.close()
    checkpoint = tmp_path / "trainer_checkpoint.json"
    checkpoint.write_text("not json", encoding="utf-8")

    with pytest.raises(json.JSONDecodeError):
        main([
            "--db", str(db),
            "--archive", str(tmp_path / "archive.sqlite"),
            "--checkpoint", str(checkpoint),
        ])

    assert _sports(db) == {"tennis", "basketball"}


def test_migrate_checkpoint_keeps_only_tennis(tmp_path):
    from betdash.db.tennis_migration import migrate_checkpoint

    payload = {
        "elo": {"tennis": {}, "basketball": {}},
        "glicko": {"tennis": {}, "basketball": {}},
        "runs": 4,
    }
    path = tmp_path / "trainer_checkpoint.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")

    report = migrate_checkpoint(path)

    assert report == {"elo": 1, "glicko": 1}
    saved = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert set(saved["elo"]) == {"tennis"}
    assert set(saved["glicko"]) == {"tennis"}
    assert saved["runs"] == 4


def test_main_runs_with_explicit_paths(tmp_path, capsys):
    from betdash.db.tennis_migration import main

    db = tmp_path / "db.sqlite"
    _db(db)
    checkpoint = tmp_path / "trainer_checkpoint.json"
    checkpoint.write_text(
        json.dumps({"elo": {"tennis": {}, "basketball": {}}, "glicko": {"tennis": {}}}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    archive = tmp_path / "archive.sqlite"

    rc = main([
        "--db", str(db),
        "--archive", str(archive),
        "--checkpoint", str(checkpoint),
    ])
    report = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)

    assert rc == 0
    assert report["canonical_events"]["basketball"] == 1
    assert set(json.loads(checkpoint.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["elo"]) == {"tennis"}

FILE: tests/ingest/test_collector.py

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import AdapterHealth, Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.ingest.collector import Collector
from betdash.normalize import EntityRegistry


NOW = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


class FakeEmptyAdapter:
    bookmaker = "pari"
    adapter_version = "fake/1"

    def fetch_snapshot(self):
        return []

    def health(self):
        return AdapterHealth(
            bookmaker="pari",
            status="degraded",
            last_success=None,
            error_count=1,
            adapter_version="fake/1",
        )


def seed_snapshot(repo: Repository) -> None:
    repo.save_snapshots(
        [
            Snapshot(
                event_uid="e1",
                bookmaker="pari",
                market="match_winner",
                outcome="p1",
                odds_decimal=2.0,
                observed_at=NOW,
                source_event_id="p1",
                adapter_version="1",
                is_live=False,
            )
        ]
    )


def test_empty_adapter_marks_degraded_and_keeps_last_snapshot(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    seed_snapshot(repo)
    registry = EntityRegistry({})
    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, [FakeEmptyAdapter()], registry)
    assert collector.poll_once() == 0
    health = {h.bookmaker: h for h in collector.health()}
    assert health["pari"].status == "degraded"
    assert len(repo.last_snapshots("e1")) == 1


class FakeAdapter:
    def __init__(self, bookmaker="pari", rows=None, raises=False, health_status="ok"):
        self.bookmaker = bookmaker
        self.adapter_version = "fake/1"
        self.rows = rows or []
        self.raises = raises
        self.health_status = health_status
        self.calls = 0

    def fetch_snapshot(self):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.raises:
            raise RuntimeError("boom")
        return list(self.rows)

    def health(self):
        return AdapterHealth(
            bookmaker=self.bookmaker,
            status=self.health_status,
            last_success=None,
            error_count=0,
            adapter_version=self.adapter_version,
        )


def make_raw(**overrides):
    from betdash.normalize.models import RawOdd

    values = dict(
        bookmaker="pari",
        source_event_id="ev1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participants=("Djokovic N.", "Sinner J."),
        market="match_winner",
        outcome="p1",
        odds_decimal=2.0,
        observed_at=NOW,
        is_live=False,
        start_at=NOW,
    )
    values.update(overrides)
    return RawOdd(**values)


def test_poll_once_skips_live_rows_and_preserves_last_good(tmp_path):

    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, [adapter], registry)
    assert collector.poll_once() == 0
    assert len(repo.last_snapshots("e1")) == 1

def saved_event_uid(raw, registry):
    from betdash.normalize import normalize_event

    return normalize_event(raw, registry).event_uid


def test_start_and_stop_register_scheduler(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    registry = EntityRegistry({})
    collector = Collector(Settings(poll_seconds=90), repo, [], registry)
    collector.start()
    try:
        assert collector._scheduler is not None
        jobs = collector._scheduler.get_jobs()
        assert len(jobs) == 1
        assert jobs[0].trigger.interval.total_seconds() == 90
    finally:
        collector.stop()
    assert collector._scheduler is None


def test_degraded_error_count_persists_across_collector_restart(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    registry = EntityRegistry({"Djokovic N.": "djokovic", "Sinner J.": "sinner"})
    last_success = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 11, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    repo.upsert_adapter_health(
        AdapterHealth(
            bookmaker="pari",
            status="degraded",
            last_success=last_success,
            error_count=3,
            adapter_version="fake/1",
        )
    )

class _SleepingAdapter:
    def __init__(self, bookmaker, delay, rows, raises=False):
        self.bookmaker = bookmaker
        self.adapter_version = "fake/1"
        self.delay = delay
        self.rows = rows
        self.raises = raises

    def fetch_snapshot(self):
        time.sleep(self.delay)
        if self.raises:
            raise RuntimeError("boom")
        return self.rows

    def health(self):
        return AdapterHealth(
            bookmaker=self.bookmaker,
            status="ok",
            last_success=None,
            error_count=0,
            adapter_version=self.adapter_version,
        )


def test_parallel_fetch_preserves_adapter_order(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "parallel.sqlite"))
    adapters = [
        _SleepingAdapter("slow", 0.15, ["slow"]),
        _SleepingAdapter("fast", 0.01, ["fast"]),
    ]
    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, adapters, EntityRegistry({}))

    started = time.monotonic()
    fetched = collector._fetch_all_adapters()
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started

    assert [row[1] for row in fetched] == ["slow", "fast"]
    assert [row[2] for row in fetched] == [["slow"], ["fast"]]
    assert elapsed < 0.25


def test_parallel_fetch_isolates_adapter_exception(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "parallel-error.sqlite"))
    adapters = [
        _SleepingAdapter("bad", 0.01, [], raises=True),
        _SleepingAdapter("good", 0.01, ["good"]),
    ]
    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, adapters, EntityRegistry({}))

    fetched = collector._fetch_all_adapters()

    assert fetched[0][1] == "bad"
    assert fetched[0][2] is None
    assert "RuntimeError: boom" in fetched[0][3]
    assert fetched[1][2] == ["good"]
    assert fetched[1][3] is None


class RecordingRepository(Repository):
    def __init__(self, path):
        super().__init__(str(path))
        self.snapshot_calls = []
        self.event_upserts = []

    def save_snapshots(self, snapshots):
        self.snapshot_calls.append(list(snapshots))
        return super().save_snapshots(snapshots)

    def upsert_canonical_event(self, canonical):
        self.event_upserts.append(canonical.event_uid)
        return super().upsert_canonical_event(canonical)


def test_poll_once_batches_writes(tmp_path):
    repo = RecordingRepository(tmp_path / "batched.sqlite")
    registry = EntityRegistry({"Djokovic N.": "djokovic", "Sinner J.": "sinner"})
    rows_a = [make_raw(bookmaker="pari", source_event_id="a")]
    rows_b = [make_raw(bookmaker="fonbet", source_event_id="b", odds_decimal=2.1)]
    adapters = [FakeAdapter(bookmaker="pari", rows=rows_a), FakeAdapter(bookmaker="fonbet", rows=rows_b)]
    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, adapters, registry)

    saved = collector.poll_once()

    assert saved == 2
    assert len(repo.snapshot_calls) == 1
    assert len(repo.snapshot_calls[0]) == 2
    assert len(repo.event_upserts) == 1


def test_poll_once_deduplicates_snapshots(tmp_path):
    repo = RecordingRepository(tmp_path / "dedupe.sqlite")
    registry = EntityRegistry({})
    raw = make_raw()
    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, [FakeAdapter(rows=[raw, raw])], registry)

    collector.poll_once()

    assert len(repo.snapshot_calls) == 1
    assert len(repo.snapshot_calls[0]) == 1


class FailingEventRepository(RecordingRepository):
    def __init__(self, path, failing_uid):
        super().__init__(path)
        self.failing_uid = failing_uid

    def upsert_canonical_event(self, canonical):
        if canonical.event_uid == self.failing_uid:
            raise ValueError("bad canonical")
        return super().upsert_canonical_event(canonical)


def test_poll_once_isolates_canonical_upsert_failure(tmp_path):
    bad_raw = make_raw(bookmaker="pari", participants=("Djokovic N.", "Sinner J."))
    good_raw = make_raw(
        bookmaker="fonbet",
        source_event_id="e2",
        participants=("Medvedev D.", "Rublev A."),
    )
    registry = EntityRegistry({
        "Djokovic N.": "djokovic",
        "Sinner J.": "sinner",
        "Medvedev D.": "medvedev",
        "Rublev A.": "rublev",
    })
    failing_uid = saved_event_uid(bad_raw, registry)
    repo = FailingEventRepository(tmp_path / "canonical-fail.sqlite", failing_uid)
    adapters = [
        FakeAdapter(bookmaker="pari", rows=[bad_raw]),
        FakeAdapter(bookmaker="fonbet", rows=[good_raw]),
    ]
    collector = Collector(Settings(), repo, adapters, registry)

    saved = collector.poll_once()

    assert saved == 2
    assert len(repo.snapshot_calls) == 1
    assert len(repo.snapshot_calls[0]) == 2
    health = {h.bookmaker: h for h in collector.health()}
    assert health["pari"].status == "degraded"
    assert health["fonbet"].status == "ok"

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json

import pytest

from betdash.live.sofascore import _clear_live_cache, fetch_live_events, fetch_live_events_cached


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clear_live_cache():
    _clear_live_cache()
    yield
    _clear_live_cache()


class _Response(io.BytesIO):
    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        return False


def _opener(payload):
    def open_url(url, timeout=None):
        assert "api.sofascore.com" in url
        assert timeout == 5
        return _Response(json.dumps(payload).encode())
    return open_url


def _event(event_id, home, away, home_translation=None):
    team = {"name": home}
    if home_translation:
        team["fieldTranslations"] = {"nameTranslation": {"ru": home_translation}}
    return {
        "id": event_id,
        "startTimestamp": 1764253200,
        "homeTeam": team,
        "awayTeam": {"name": away},
        "homeScore": {"current": 1},
        "awayScore": {"current": 2},
        "status": {"description": "1st set"},
        "tournament": {"name": "ATP Cup"},
        "category": {"slug": "tennis"},
    }


def test_fetch_live_events_parses_all_supported_sports():
    payload = {"events": [_event(1, "Djokovic", "Alcaraz", "Джокович"), _event(2, "Team A", "Team B")]}

    assert fetch_live_events("tennis", opener=_opener(payload)) == [
        {
            "event_id": 1,
            "start_at": "2025-11-27T14:20:00+00:00",
            "home": "Джокович",
            "away": "Alcaraz",
            "home_score": 1,
            "away_score": 2,
            "status": "1st set",
            "tournament": "ATP Cup",
            "url": "https://www.sofascore.com/event/1",
        },
        {
            "event_id": 2,
            "start_at": "2025-11-27T14:20:00+00:00",
            "home": "Team A",
            "away": "Team B",
            "home_score": 1,
            "away_score": 2,
            "status": "1st set",
            "tournament": "ATP Cup",
            "url": "https://www.sofascore.com/event/2",
        },
    ]


def test_live_events_returns_empty_on_http_error():
    def broken(url, timeout=None):
        raise OSError("offline")

    assert fetch_live_events("tennis", opener=broken) == []


def test_live_events_tolerates_malformed_payload():
    def bad_json(url, timeout=None):
        return _Response(b"{not json")

    assert fetch_live_events("tennis", opener=bad_json) == []


def test_fetch_live_events_rejects_unknown_sport():
    assert fetch_live_events("hockey", opener=_opener({"events": []})) == []


def test_cached_live_events_reuses_fresh_response():
    calls = []

    def opener(url, timeout=None):
        calls.append(url)
        return _opener({"events": [_event(1, "Djokovic", "Alcaraz")]})(url, timeout)

    first = fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=opener, now=lambda: 100)
    second = fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=opener, now=lambda: 110)

    assert first == second
    assert len(calls) == 1


def test_cached_live_events_refetches_after_ttl():
    calls = []

    def opener(url, timeout=None):
        calls.append(url)
        return _opener({"events": [_event(1, "Djokovic", "Alcaraz")]})(url, timeout)

    fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=opener, ttl_seconds=30, now=lambda: 100)
    fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=opener, ttl_seconds=30, now=lambda: 200)

    assert len(calls) == 2


def test_cached_live_events_returns_last_good_rows_on_error():
    def broken(url, timeout=None):
        raise OSError("offline")

    good = fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=_opener({"events": [_event(7, "Rublev", "Zverev")]}), now=lambda: 100)
    fallback = fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=broken, now=lambda: 200)

    assert [row["event_id"] for row in fallback] == [row["event_id"] for row in good]
    assert all(row["_stale"] for row in fallback)


def test_cached_live_events_marks_fresh_rows_not_stale():
    rows = fetch_live_events_cached(
        "tennis", opener=_opener({"events": [_event(8, "Sinner", "Fritz")]}), now=lambda: 100
    )
    assert all(row["_stale"] is False for row in rows)


def test_cached_live_events_stops_stale_fallback_after_max_age():
    def broken(url, timeout=None):
        raise OSError("offline")

    fetch_live_events_cached(
        "tennis", opener=_opener({"events": [_event(9, "Rublev", "Zverev")]}), now=lambda: 100
    )
    fallback = fetch_live_events_cached(
        "tennis",
        opener=broken,
        ttl_seconds=30,
        max_fallback_age_seconds=60,
        now=lambda: 500,
    )
    assert fallback == []


def test_cached_live_events_returns_copies():
    from betdash.live import sofascore

    fetch_live_events_cached(
        "tennis", opener=_opener({"events": [_event(10, "Sinner", "Fritz")]}), now=lambda: 100
    )
    first = fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=broken_opener, now=lambda: 105)
    first[0]["home"] = "mutated"
    second = fetch_live_events_cached("tennis", opener=broken_opener, now=lambda: 106)
    assert second[0]["home"] == "Sinner"
    assert sofascore._LIVE_CACHE["tennis"][1][0]["home"] == "Sinner"


def broken_opener(url, timeout=None):
    raise OSError("offline")


def test_cached_live_events_uses_monotonic_clock_by_default():
    from pathlib import Path

    import betdash.live.sofascore as sofascore

    source = Path(sofascore.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "time.monotonic()" in source

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.db.repository import Snapshot
from betdash.markets.consensus import best_price, consensus_prob
from betdash.markets.de_vig import implied_probs


NOW = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def make_snapshot(bookmaker: str, outcome: str, odds_decimal: float, *, market: str = "match_winner", event_uid: str = "e1") -> Snapshot:
    return Snapshot(
        event_uid=event_uid,
        bookmaker=bookmaker,
        market=market,
        outcome=outcome,
        odds_decimal=odds_decimal,
        observed_at=NOW,
        source_event_id=f"{bookmaker}-{outcome}",
        adapter_version="1",
    )


def test_de_vig_removes_margin():
    p = implied_probs([1.90, 2.10])
    assert abs(sum(p) - 1.0) < 1e-9


def test_single_book_consensus_returns_zero_coverage():
    snaps = [make_snapshot("pari", "p1", 2.0)]
    prob, coverage = consensus_prob(snaps, "p1")
    assert coverage == 0 and prob == 0.0


def test_consensus_de_vigs_each_book_then_averages():
    # Book A: 2.0/2.0 -> fair 0.5/0.5. Book B: 1.8/2.2 -> inverses 0.555..,0.4545..
    # normalized p1 = 0.55, p2 = 0.45. Consensus for p1 = (0.5 + 0.55) / 2.
    snaps = [
        make_snapshot("a", "p1", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("a", "p2", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("b", "p1", 1.8),
        make_snapshot("b", "p2", 2.2),
    ]
    prob, coverage = consensus_prob(snaps, "p1")
    assert coverage == 2
    assert abs(prob - 0.525) < 1e-9


def test_consensus_ignores_books_with_fewer_than_two_outcomes():
    snaps = [
        make_snapshot("a", "p1", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("a", "p2", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("b", "p1", 1.5),  # only one outcome present
        make_snapshot("c", "p1", 1.9),
        make_snapshot("c", "p2", 2.1),
    ]
    prob, coverage = consensus_prob(snaps, "p1")
    assert coverage == 2
    assert 0.0 < prob < 1.0


def test_consensus_returns_zero_when_coverage_below_two():
    snaps = [
        make_snapshot("a", "p1", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("a", "p2", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("b", "p1", 1.8),  # missing p2
    ]
    prob, coverage = consensus_prob(snaps, "p1")
    assert prob == 0.0
    assert coverage == 1


def test_consensus_excludes_book_missing_target_outcome():
    snaps = [
        make_snapshot("a", "p1", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("a", "p2", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("b", "p2", 1.8),
        make_snapshot("b", "p3", 2.1),  # has two outcomes, but no p1
        make_snapshot("c", "p1", 1.9),
        make_snapshot("c", "p2", 2.1),
    ]
    prob, coverage = consensus_prob(snaps, "p1")
    assert coverage == 2
    assert 0.0 < prob < 1.0


def test_best_price_returns_maximum_or_none():
    snaps = [
        make_snapshot("a", "p1", 2.0),
        make_snapshot("b", "p1", 2.2),
        make_snapshot("c", "p2", 3.0),
    ]
    assert best_price(snaps, "p1") == 2.2
    assert best_price(snaps, "p2") == 3.0
    assert best_price(snaps, "missing") is None


def test_clv_excluded_without_closing_snapshot():
    from betdash.markets.consensus import clv_included

    assert clv_included(True) is True
    assert clv_included(False) is False

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.models.baseline import EloRating, GlickoRating
from betdash.models.features import build_features
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.results.ingest import ResultRow


NOW = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
START = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def _seed_repo(tmp_path) -> Repository:
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("p1", "p2"),
        start_at=START,
        mapping_confidence=0.99,
    )
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    repo.save_snapshots(
        [
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, NOW, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, NOW, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, NOW, "s2", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, NOW, "s2", "v1"),
        ]
    )
    repo.save_result(
        "e1",
        ResultRow(
            participant_a="p1",
            participant_b="p2",
            date="2026-01-10",
            score="2-0",
            league="ATP",
        ),
    )
    return repo


def test_elo_probability_range():
    elo = EloRating()
    p = elo.probability("a", "b")
    assert 0.0 < p < 1.0


def test_glicko_probability_range():
    g = GlickoRating()
    p = g.probability("a", "b")
    assert 0.0 < p < 1.0


def test_build_features_returns_float_dict(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    event = repo.events_for_resolution()[0]
    features = build_features(event, repo)
    assert isinstance(features, dict)
    assert features
    assert all(isinstance(k, str) for k in features)
    assert all(
        isinstance(v, float) for k, v in features.items() if k != "surface_name"
    )


def test_build_features_excludes_future_snapshots(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    start = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    event = CanonicalEvent("e1", "tennis", "ATP", ("p1", "p2"), start, 0.99)
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    before = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    after = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 19, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    repo.save_snapshots(
        [
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, before, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, before, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, before, "s2", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, before, "s2", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 9.0, after, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 1.1, after, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 9.0, after, "s2", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 1.1, after, "s2", "v1"),
        ]
    )
    f = build_features(event, repo)
    # implied from 2.0/2.0 odds before start, not post-start 9.0/1.1
    assert 0.45 < f["market_p1_consensus"] < 0.55


def test_build_features_ddmmyyyy_result_does_not_leak(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e2",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("p1", "p2"),
        start_at=datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=0.99,
    )
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    # Future result stored as DD/MM/YYYY - must not be used as history for event on 2026-01-10
    repo.save_result("e3", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="11/01/2026", score="2-0", league="ATP"))
    # Past result
    repo.save_result("e0", ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date="09/01/2026", score="0-2", league="ATP"))
    f = build_features(event, repo)
    # If future leaked, p1 form would be 1.0; with only past 0-2 loss, p1 form is 0.0
    assert f["p1_form"] == 0.0
    assert f["h2h_p1"] == 0.0

from betdash.models.baseline import EloRating, _welo_weight, score_margin


def test_welo_updates_more_for_decisive_score():
    close = EloRating(k=20.0)
    decisive = EloRating(k=20.0)
    close.update("A", "B", 1.0, weight=_welo_weight(score_margin("6-4 7-6")))
    decisive.update("A", "B", 1.0, weight=_welo_weight(score_margin("6-0 6-0")))
    assert decisive.get("A") > close.get("A")


def test_welo_missing_score_uses_neutral_weight():
    assert _welo_weight(score_margin(None)) == 1.0


def test_score_margin_ignores_tiebreak_points():
    assert score_margin("6-7(4-6) 7-5") == 3.0

from betdash.models.trainer import barnett_clarke_hold_rates


def test_hold_rates_use_opponent_return_and_have_defaults():
    rates = barnett_clarke_hold_rates(
        {
            "p1_srv_win": 0.68,
            "p2_srv_win": 0.51,
            "p1_ret_win": 0.38,
            "p2_ret_win": 0.32,
        }
    )
    assert rates[0] == (0.68 + (1.0 - 0.32)) / 2
    assert rates[1] == (0.51 + (1.0 - 0.38)) / 2

    defaults = barnett_clarke_hold_rates({})
    assert defaults == (0.62, 0.62)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from betdash.analytics.calibration import kelly_fraction
from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot

from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.results.ingest import ResultRow

START = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
DECISION = START - timedelta(hours=1)


def _seed_repo(tmp_path: Path, score: str = "6-0 6-0") -> Repository:
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",

    )

    repo.save_snapshots(

            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, DECISION, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, DECISION, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, DECISION, "s2", "v1"),

def test_welo_weight_is_wired_into_trainer_rating_updates(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    trainer = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))

    trainer.step()

    # Plain Elo with k=20 and p=0.5 lands on 1510. A decisive 6-0 6-0 score
    # must move the rating further via _welo_weight (weight ~= 1.63 here).
    assert trainer._elo["tennis"].get("p1") > 1515.0


def test_market_prior_requires_fresh_nonlive_and_two_books():
    fresh = [
        Snapshot("e", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, DECISION, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, DECISION, "s1", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, DECISION, "s2", "v1"),
        Snapshot("e", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, DECISION, "s2", "v1"),
    ]
    stale = Snapshot("e", "b3", "match_winner", "p1", 1.05, START - timedelta(hours=20), "s3", "v1")
    live = Snapshot("e", "b4", "match_winner", "p1", 1.05, DECISION, "s4", "v1", is_live=True)

    prob, coverage = Trainer._market_p1_from_snapshots(fresh + [stale, live], START)

    assert coverage == 2
    assert 0.0 < prob < 1.0
    one_book = [fresh[0], fresh[1]]
    assert Trainer._market_p1_from_snapshots(one_book, START) == (0.0, 1)


def test_market_probs_uses_real_prior_only_with_coverage():
    trainer = Trainer.__new__(Trainer)

    low = trainer._market_probs("match_winner", None, {}, 0.7, object(), alpha=0.3, market_p1=0.4, coverage_books=1)
    good = trainer._market_probs("match_winner", None, {}, 0.7, object(), alpha=0.3, market_p1=0.4, coverage_books=2)

    assert low["p1"] == pytest.approx(0.7)
    assert low["p2"] == pytest.approx(0.3)
    assert good["p1"] == pytest.approx(0.61)


def test_oof_metrics_use_actual_market_pairs_and_stakes(tmp_path):

def test_generate_predictions_applies_oof_calibration(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path, score="6-0 6-0")
    # Add a separate near-future, unresolved event so predictions are generated
    # and the market prior is inside the freshness window.
    future = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1)
    recent = future - timedelta(minutes=30)
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(
        CanonicalEvent(
            event_uid="cal", sport="tennis", league="ATP",
            participant_ids=("p1", "p2"), start_at=future, mapping_confidence=0.99,
        )
    )
    repo.save_snapshots(
        [
            Snapshot("cal", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, recent, "s9", "v1"),
            Snapshot("cal", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, recent, "s9", "v1"),
            Snapshot("cal", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, recent, "s10", "v1"),
            Snapshot("cal", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, recent, "s10", "v1"),
        ]
    )
    trainer = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    breaks = [(0.0, 1.0, 0.9)]

    preds = trainer._generate_predictions(
        "run", None, {"tennis": __import__("betdash.models.baseline", fromlist=["EloRating"]).EloRating()},
        {"tennis": __import__("betdash.models.baseline", fromlist=["GlickoRating"]).GlickoRating()},
        calibration_breaks=breaks,
    )

    p1 = [p for p in preds if p["outcome"] == "p1"]
    assert p1
    assert p1[0]["model_prob"] == pytest.approx(0.9)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import Repository, init_db
from betdash.models.baseline import EloRating, GlickoRating
from betdash.models.trainer import Trainer
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent


def test_generate_predictions_reuses_cached_results(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "reuse.db"))
    init_db(repo.path)
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="future-match",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz"),
        start_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)

    seen = {}

    def fake_build_features(event, repo, **kwargs):
        seen.update(kwargs)
        return {"p1_srv_win": 0.62, "p2_srv_win": 0.58}

    monkeypatch.setattr("betdash.models.trainer.build_features", fake_build_features)
    trainer = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    trainer._generate_predictions(
        "run",
        None,
        {"tennis": EloRating()},
        {"tennis": GlickoRating()},
    )

    assert "cached_results" in seen
    assert isinstance(seen["cached_results"], list)


def test_generate_predictions_loads_results_only_once(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "once.db"))
    init_db(repo.path)
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="future-once",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz"),
        start_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)

    calls = {"n": 0}
    original_results = repo.results

    def counted_results(*args, **kwargs):
        calls["n"] += 1
        return original_results(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(repo, "results", counted_results)
    trainer = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt-once")))
    trainer._generate_predictions(
        "run",
        None,
        {"tennis": EloRating()},
        {"tennis": GlickoRating()},
    )

    assert calls["n"] == 1




FILE: tests/models/test_trainer.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.models.trainer import Trainer
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.results.ingest import ResultRow


NOW = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
START = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def _seed_repo(tmp_path) -> Repository:
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("p1", "p2"),
        start_at=START,
        mapping_confidence=0.99,
    )
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
    repo.save_snapshots(
        [
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, NOW, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, NOW, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, NOW, "s2", "v1"),
            Snapshot("e1", "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, NOW, "s2", "v1"),
        ]
    )
    repo.save_result(
        "e1",
        ResultRow(
            participant_a="p1",
            participant_b="p2",
            date="2026-01-10",
            score="2-0",
            league="ATP",
        ),
    )
    return repo


def test_trainer_resumes_after_restart(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    t1 = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    t1.step()
    t2 = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    assert t2.last_run_id == t1.last_run_id
    assert t2.step().features_version == t1.step().features_version


def test_trainer_writes_model_run(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    t = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    run = t.step()
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT run_id, features_version FROM model_runs WHERE run_id=?", (run.run_id,)).fetchone()
    assert row is not None
    assert row["features_version"] == run.features_version


def test_trainer_start_stop(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    t = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt"), poll_seconds=1))
    t.start()
    try:
        deadline = time.time() + 3
        while t.last_run_id is None and time.time() < deadline:
            time.sleep(0.05)
        assert t.last_run_id is not None
    finally:
        t.stop()
    # checkpoint should be valid JSON
    ckpt = (tmp_path / "ckpt" / "trainer_checkpoint.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    data = json.loads(ckpt)
    assert data["last_run_id"] == t.last_run_id


def test_trainer_step_is_idempotent_no_new_data(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    t = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    r1 = t.step()
    state1 = json.loads((tmp_path / "ckpt" / "trainer_checkpoint.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    elo1 = {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in t._elo.items()}
    g1 = {s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()} for s, r in t._glicko.items()}

    r2 = t.step()
    state2 = json.loads((tmp_path / "ckpt" / "trainer_checkpoint.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    elo2 = {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in t._elo.items()}
    g2 = {s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()} for s, r in t._glicko.items()}

    assert elo1 == elo2
    assert g1 == g2
    assert state1.get("processed_event_uids") == state2.get("processed_event_uids")
    # model runs may differ in run_id/created_at, but no drift in processed state
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        m1 = conn.execute("SELECT metrics_json FROM model_runs WHERE run_id=?", (r1.run_id,)).fetchone()
        m2 = conn.execute("SELECT metrics_json FROM model_runs WHERE run_id=?", (r2.run_id,)).fetchone()
    assert json.loads(m1["metrics_json"])["samples"] == json.loads(m2["metrics_json"])["samples"]


def test_trainer_walk_forward_metrics_recorded(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "b.sqlite"))
    # two chronological events -> one walk-forward fold (train on first, test on second)
    for i, uid in enumerate(["e1", "e2"], start=1):
        start = datetime(2026, 1, 10 + i, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        obs = datetime(2026, 1, 10 + i, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        event = CanonicalEvent(uid, "tennis", "ATP", ("p1", "p2"), start, 0.99)
        repo.upsert_canonical_event(event)
        repo.save_snapshots([
            Snapshot(uid, "b1", "match_winner", "p1", 2.0, obs, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot(uid, "b1", "match_winner", "p2", 2.0, obs, "s1", "v1"),
            Snapshot(uid, "b2", "match_winner", "p1", 1.9, obs, "s2", "v1"),
            Snapshot(uid, "b2", "match_winner", "p2", 2.1, obs, "s2", "v1"),
        ])
        repo.save_result(uid, ResultRow(participant_a="p1", participant_b="p2", date=f"2026-01-{10+i}", score="2-0", league="ATP"))

    t = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    run = t.step()
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT metrics_json FROM model_runs WHERE run_id=?", (run.run_id,)).fetchone()
    metrics = json.loads(row["metrics_json"])
    wf = metrics["walk_forward"]
    assert wf["predictions"] == 1
    assert len(wf["folds"]) == 1
    assert wf["folds"][0]["train_size"] == 1
    assert wf["folds"][0]["test_event_uids"] == ["e2"]


def test_trainer_step_rolls_back_on_failure(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    t = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))

    # baseline clean run for expected ratings
    clean = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "clean")))
    clean.step()
    expected_elo = {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in clean._elo.items()}
    expected_glicko = {
        s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()}
        for s, r in clean._glicko.items()
    }

    original_write = t._write_model_run

    def boom(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("boom")

    t._write_model_run = boom  # type: ignore[assignment]
    try:
        t.step()
    except RuntimeError:
        pass
    finally:
        t._write_model_run = original_write  # type: ignore[assignment]

    # failure before commit must not leave mutated in-memory ratings/state
    assert {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in t._elo.items()} == {}
    assert {s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()} for s, r in t._glicko.items()} == {}
    assert t._state.get("processed_event_uids") == []

    # next step should apply exactly once
    t.step()
    assert {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in t._elo.items()} == expected_elo
    assert {
        s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()}
        for s, r in t._glicko.items()
    } == expected_glicko
    assert t._state.get("processed_event_uids") == ["e1"]


def test_trainer_restart_step_no_new_data_no_drift(tmp_path):
    repo = _seed_repo(tmp_path)
    t1 = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    t1.step()
    elo1 = {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in t1._elo.items()}
    g1 = {s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()} for s, r in t1._glicko.items()}

    t2 = Trainer(repo, Settings(checkpoint_dir=str(tmp_path / "ckpt")))
    t2.step()
    elo2 = {s: dict(r.ratings) for s, r in t2._elo.items()}
    g2 = {s: {k: (v.rating, v.rd) for k, v in r.ratings.items()} for s, r in t2._glicko.items()}

    assert elo1 == elo2
    assert g1 == g2
    assert t2._state.get("processed_event_uids") == ["e1"]
