FILE: tests/models/test_trainer_score_distributions.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.models import trainer
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent


class FakeRepo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.prediction_saves = 0

    def save_predictions(self, rows):
        self.prediction_saves += 1
        return len(rows)


def test_build_score_distribution_rows_creates_three_providers(monkeypatch):
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz"),
        start_at=datetime(2026, 11, 28, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer,
        "build_features",
        lambda *a, **k: {
            "surface": "hard",
            "p1_srv_win": 0.65,
            "p2_srv_win": 0.55,
            "p1_ret_win": 0.35,
            "p2_ret_win": 0.40,
            "p1_elo_blend": 1550.0,
            "p2_elo_blend": 1450.0,
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer,
        "empirical_provider_distribution",
        lambda repo, p1, p2, target: {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.6, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.4},
    )
    repo = FakeRepo()

    rows = trainer.build_score_distribution_rows(
        event, repo, 0.6, "run-1", datetime(2026, 11, 28, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert {row["provider"] for row in rows} == {"empirical", "markov", "blend"}
    assert all(abs(sum(row["distribution"].values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9 for row in rows)
    assert repo.prediction_saves == 0


def test_markov_uses_server_hold_rates(monkeypatch):
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e4",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz"),
        start_at=datetime(2026, 11, 28, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer,
        "build_features",
        lambda *a, **k: {
            "surface": 0.0,
            "surface_name": "hard",
            "best_of": 3,
            "p1_srv_win": 0.68,
            "p2_srv_win": 0.51,
            "p1_ret_win": 0.32,
            "p2_ret_win": 0.49,
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer,
        "empirical_provider_distribution",
        lambda repo, p1, p2, target: {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 1.0},
    )
    captured = {}

    def fake_markov(p1_hold, p2_hold, **kwargs):
        captured["holds"] = (p1_hold, p2_hold)
        return {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 1.0}

    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer, "markov_score_distribution", fake_markov)

    trainer.build_score_distribution_rows(
        event, FakeRepo(), 0.6, "run-1", datetime(2026, 11, 28, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert captured["holds"] == (0.595, 0.595)


def test_elo_gap_is_converted_to_rank_units(monkeypatch):
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e3",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz"),
        start_at=datetime(2026, 11, 28, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer,
        "build_features",
        lambda *a, **k: {
            "surface": "hard",
            "p1_srv_win": 0.65,
            "p2_srv_win": 0.55,
            "p1_ret_win": 0.35,
            "p2_ret_win": 0.40,
            "p1_elo_blend": 1700.0,
            "p2_elo_blend": 1500.0,
        },
    )
    captured = {}

    def fake_empirical(repo, p1, p2, target):
        captured["target"] = target
        return {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 1.0}

    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer, "empirical_provider_distribution", fake_empirical)

    trainer.build_score_distribution_rows(
        event, FakeRepo(), 0.6, "run-1", datetime(2026, 11, 28, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert abs(captured["target"]["elo_gap"] - (200.0 / 15.0)) < 1e-6


def test_build_features_exposes_surface_for_score_context(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from betdash.db.repository import Repository
    from betdash.models import features

FILE: tests/normalize/test_alias_generator.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

import json

from betdash.data.sackmann import ensure_sackmann_tables
from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.normalize.alias_generator import (
    generate_sackmann_aliases,
    main,
    sackmann_alias_variants,
    write_sackmann_aliases,
)


def test_sackmann_alias_variants_cover_bookmaker_orders():
    assert sackmann_alias_variants("Taylor Fritz") == {
        "Taylor Fritz",
        "T Fritz",
        "T. Fritz",
        "Fritz Taylor",
        "Fritz T",
        "Fritz T.",
        "Fritz",
        "FritzT",
        "FritzT.",
    }


def test_generate_and_write_aliases_preserve_manual_overrides(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "aliases.db"
    repo = Repository(str(db))
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (tour, tourney_id, tourney_date, winner_name, loser_name) "
            "VALUES ('atp','t','20260101','Taylor Fritz','Andrey Rublev')"
        )
    path = tmp_path / "aliases.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps({"Taylor Fritz": ["Тэйлор Фриц"]}), encoding="utf-8")

    generated = generate_sackmann_aliases(repo)
    assert "Fritz T." in generated["Taylor Fritz"]
    assert "Rublev A." in generated["Andrey Rublev"]

    written = write_sackmann_aliases(repo, path)
    stored = json.loads(written.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert "Тэйлор Фриц" in stored["Taylor Fritz"]
    assert stored["Andrey Rublev"] == sorted(stored["Andrey Rublev"])


def test_write_sackmann_aliases_invalidates_runtime_caches(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from betdash.analytics import prediction_links
    from betdash.models import features

    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "cache.db"))
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (tour, tourney_id, tourney_date, winner_name, loser_name) "
            "VALUES ('atp','t','20260101','Taylor Fritz','Andrey Rublev')"
        )
    monkeypatch.setattr(features, "_SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP", {"stale": "x"})
    monkeypatch.setattr(prediction_links, "_ALIAS_REVERSE", {"stale": "x"})

    write_sackmann_aliases(repo, tmp_path / "aliases.json")

    assert features._SACKMANN_PLAYER_ALIAS_MAP is None
    assert prediction_links._ALIAS_REVERSE is None


def test_generate_sackmann_aliases_can_limit_to_frequent_players(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "limit.db"
    repo = Repository(str(db))
    with repo.connection() as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        for i in range(3):
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (tour, tourney_id, tourney_date, winner_name, loser_name) "
                "VALUES ('atp',?,?,?,?)",
                (f"t{i}", "20260101", "Frequent Player", "Rare Player"),
            )
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (tour, tourney_id, tourney_date, winner_name, loser_name) "
            "VALUES ('atp','other','20260101','Second Player','Rare Player')"
        )

    generated = generate_sackmann_aliases(repo, limit=2)

    assert set(generated) == {"Frequent Player", "Rare Player"}


def test_write_sackmann_aliases_drops_stale_canonicals(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "stale.db"
    repo = Repository(str(db))
    with repo.connection() as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (tour, tourney_id, tourney_date, winner_name, loser_name) "
            "VALUES ('atp','t','20260101','Taylor Fritz','Andrey Rublev')"
        )
    target = tmp_path / "aliases.json"
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps({"Taylor Fritz": ["Тэйлор Фриц"], "Old Player": ["Старый Игрок"]}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    write_sackmann_aliases(repo, target, limit=2)
    stored = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    assert "Old Player" not in stored
    assert "Taylor Fritz" in stored
    assert "Тэйлор Фриц" in stored["Taylor Fritz"]


def test_alias_generator_cli_writes_requested_path(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "cli.db"
    repo = Repository(str(db))
    with repo.connection() as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (tour, tourney_id, tourney_date, winner_name, loser_name) "
            "VALUES ('atp','t','20260101','Taylor Fritz','Andrey Rublev')"
        )
    target = tmp_path / "generated.json"

    assert main(["--db", str(db), "--output", str(target)]) == 0
    stored = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert "Fritz T." in stored["Taylor Fritz"]




FILE: tests/normalize/test_registry.py

"""Tests for the canonical event contract, alias registry and market mapping."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest

from betdash.normalize import (
    CanonicalEvent,
    EntityRegistry,
    MarketMapping,
    RawOdd,
    canon_market,
    canon_market_mapping,
    canon_sport,
    canonical_outcome,
    normalize_event,
    normalize_name,
)

FIXTURE = "tests/normalize/fixtures/aliases.json"
NOW = datetime(2026, 3, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
BOOKMAKERS = ("winline", "pari", "fonbet", "marathon", "betboom", "bettery")
CANONICAL_LABELS = {
    "match_winner": "П1",
    "set_handicap": "Фора по сетам",
    "total_games": "Тотал геймов",
    "game_handicap": "Фора",
    "total_points": "Тотал очков",
}


def make_raw(**overrides) -> RawOdd:
    values = {
        "bookmaker": "pari",
        "source_event_id": "123",
        "sport": "tennis",
        "league": "ATP",
        "participants": ("Djokovic N.", "Alcaraz C."),
        "market": "П1",
        "outcome": "p1",
        "odds_decimal": 1.8,
        "observed_at": NOW,
        "is_live": False,
    }
    values.update(overrides)
    return RawOdd(**values)


def registry() -> EntityRegistry:
    return EntityRegistry.from_json(FIXTURE)


# --- entity normalization -------------------------------------------------


def test_normalize_event_resolves_aliases():
    reg = registry()
    raw = RawOdd(
        bookmaker="pari",
        source_event_id="123",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participants=("Djokovic N.", "Alcaraz C."),
        market="П1",
        outcome="p1",
        odds_decimal=1.8,
        observed_at=NOW,
        is_live=False,
    )
    ev = normalize_event(raw, reg)
    assert ev.participant_ids == ("atp:djokovic", "atp:alcaraz")
    assert ev.mapping_confidence >= 0.8


def test_ambiguous_mapping_is_low_confidence():
    reg = registry()
    raw = make_raw(participants=("Ivanov", "Petrov"))
    assert normalize_event(raw, reg).mapping_confidence < 0.5


def test_unknown_mapping_uses_deterministic_name_confidence():
    reg = registry()
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(participants=("Nobody", "Someone")), reg)
    assert ev.mapping_confidence == 0.6


def test_one_unknown_participant_uses_mixed_confidence():
    reg = registry()
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(participants=("Djokovic N.", "Someone")), reg)
    assert ev.mapping_confidence == 0.6


def test_ambiguous_participants_get_provisional_ids():
    reg = registry()
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(participants=("Ivanov", "Petrov")), reg)
    assert ev.participant_ids == ("ambiguous:ivanov", "ambiguous:petrov")


def test_unknown_participants_get_deterministic_name_ids():
    reg = registry()
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(participants=("Nobody", "Someone")), reg)
    assert ev.participant_ids == ("name:nobody", "name:someone")


def test_canonical_event_keeps_observation_time_as_start():
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(), registry())
    assert ev.start_at == NOW


def test_normalize_event_propagates_explicit_start_at():
    start = NOW + timedelta(days=2)
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(start_at=start), registry())
    assert ev.start_at == start


def test_event_uid_uses_start_at_date():
    reg = registry()
    first = normalize_event(make_raw(start_at=NOW + timedelta(days=1)), reg)
    second = normalize_event(make_raw(start_at=NOW + timedelta(days=2)), reg)
    assert first.event_uid != second.event_uid


def test_event_uid_without_start_at_matches_explicit_observed_at():
    reg = registry()
    implicit = normalize_event(make_raw(), reg)
    explicit = normalize_event(make_raw(start_at=NOW), reg)
    assert implicit.start_at == NOW
    assert implicit.event_uid == explicit.event_uid


def test_event_uid_uses_utc_date_of_start_at():
    reg = registry()
    msk = timezone(timedelta(hours=3))
    # 2026-03-02 01:00 MSK is 2026-03-01 22:00 UTC.
    local = make_raw(start_at=datetime(2026, 3, 2, 1, 0, tzinfo=msk))
    utc = make_raw(start_at=datetime(2026, 3, 1, 22, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert normalize_event(local, reg).event_uid == normalize_event(utc, reg).event_uid


def test_canonical_event_keeps_raw_league_display():
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(league="ATP"), registry())
    assert ev.league == "ATP"
    assert ev.sport == "tennis"


def test_normalize_event_is_case_insensitive_for_sport():
    ev = normalize_event(make_raw(sport="Tennis"), registry())
    assert ev.sport == "tennis"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw", ["basketball", "dota2", "cs2", "football", "NBA"])
def test_non_tennis_sport_is_unknown(raw):
    assert canon_sport(raw) == ""


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "raw",
    ["table tennis", "tabletennis", "table-tennis", "non-tennis", "not tennis", "настольный теннис"],
)
def test_tennis_substrings_are_not_tennis(raw):
    assert canon_sport(raw) == ""


def test_map_markets_are_not_canonical():
    assert canon_market("map_winner", "marathon") == "unknown_map_winner"
    assert canon_market("total maps", "marathon") == "unknown_total_maps"
    assert canon_market("map handicap", "marathon") == "unknown_map_handicap"


# --- deterministic event ids ---------------------------------------------


def test_event_uid_is_sha1_hex():
    uid = normalize_event(make_raw(), registry()).event_uid
    assert len(uid) == 40
    int(uid, 16)


def test_event_uid_is_stable_across_books_and_participant_order():
    reg = registry()
    first = normalize_event(make_raw(bookmaker="pari"), reg)
    second = normalize_event(
        make_raw(
            bookmaker="winline",
            source_event_id="999",
            participants=("Alcaraz C.", "Djokovic N."),
        ),
        reg,
    )
    assert first.event_uid == second.event_uid
    assert first.participant_ids == ("atp:djokovic", "atp:alcaraz")
    assert second.participant_ids == ("atp:alcaraz", "atp:djokovic")


def test_canonical_outcome_follows_sorted_participant_ids():
    reg = registry()
    raw = make_raw(participants=("Djokovic N.", "Alcaraz C."), outcome="p1")
    ev = normalize_event(raw, reg)
    # Raw p1 is Djokovic; sorted canonical ids put Alcaraz first.
    assert canonical_outcome(raw, ev) == "p2"
    reversed_raw = make_raw(participants=("Alcaraz C.", "Djokovic N."), outcome="p1")
    assert canonical_outcome(reversed_raw, normalize_event(reversed_raw, reg)) == "p1"


def test_event_uid_changes_with_date():
    reg = registry()
    today = normalize_event(make_raw(), reg)
    tomorrow = normalize_event(make_raw(observed_at=NOW + timedelta(days=1)), reg)
    assert today.event_uid != tomorrow.event_uid


def test_event_uid_uses_normalized_league():
    reg = registry()
    assert (
        normalize_event(make_raw(league="ATP"), reg).event_uid
        == normalize_event(make_raw(league="  atp "), reg).event_uid
    )


def test_event_uid_uses_normalized_sport():
    reg = registry()
    assert (
        normalize_event(make_raw(sport="Tennis"), reg).event_uid
        == normalize_event(make_raw(sport="tennis"), reg).event_uid
    )


def test_event_uid_differs_for_different_participants():
    reg = registry()
    other = make_raw(participants=("Djokovic N.", "Ivanov"))
    assert (
        normalize_event(make_raw(), reg).event_uid
        != normalize_event(other, reg).event_uid
    )


def test_event_uid_differs_for_different_league():
    reg = registry()
    atp = normalize_event(make_raw(league="ATP"), reg)
    atp500 = normalize_event(make_raw(league="ATP 500"), reg)
    assert atp.event_uid != atp500.event_uid


# --- name normalization ---------------------------------------------------


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("raw", "expected"),
    [
        ("Djokovic N.", "djokovic n"),
        ("  O'Connell   C. ", "o connell c"),

        ("Team_2", "team 2"),
        ("", ""),
    ],

def test_normalize_name_strips_punctuation_and_case(raw, expected):

def test_registry_resolves_unique_alias():

    assert reg.resolve("Djokovic N.") == ("atp:djokovic",)
    assert reg.resolve("джокович н.") == ("atp:djokovic",)


def test_registry_resolve_ambiguous_alias_returns_all_candidates():

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.results.ingest import ingest_tennis_results_report


def test_ingest_report_counts(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / 'bet.sqlite'))
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid='e1', sport='tennis', league='ATP', participant_ids=('Djokovic N.','Alcaraz C.'),
        start_at=datetime(2026,3,1,12,0,tzinfo=timezone.utc), mapping_confidence=1.0,
    ))
    csv_path = tmp_path / 'r.csv'
    csv_path.write_text('Date,Winner,Loser,Score,Tournament\n2026-03-01,Djokovic N.,Alcaraz C.,6-4 6-4,ATP\n2026-03-01,Nadal R.,Alcaraz C.,6-4 6-4,ATP\n', encoding='utf-8')
    report = ingest_tennis_results_report(csv_path, repo)
    d = report.as_dict()
    assert d['parsed'] == 2
    assert d['stored'] == 1
    assert d['matched'] == 1
    assert d['unmatched'] == 1
    assert int(report) == 1




FILE: tests/results/test_resolve.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent
from betdash.results.ingest import ResultRow, ingest_tennis_results, parse_tennis_results
from betdash.results.resolve import resolve_result
from betdash.db.repository import Repository


def make_event(event_uid: str, p1: str, p2: str, date: str) -> CanonicalEvent:
    return CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid=event_uid,
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=(p1, p2),
        start_at=datetime.fromisoformat(f"{date}T12:00:00+00:00"),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )


def make_result(p1: str, p2: str, date: str, score: str = "6-4 6-4", league: str = "ATP") -> ResultRow:
    return ResultRow(participant_a=p1, participant_b=p2, date=date, score=score, league=league)


def test_ambiguous_result_returns_none():
    events = [make_event("e1", "Djokovic", "Alcaraz", "2026-03-01"),
              make_event("e2", "Djokovic", "Alcaraz", "2026-03-01")]
    assert resolve_result(make_result("Djokovic", "Alcaraz", "2026-03-01"), events) is None


def test_no_match_returns_none():
    events = [make_event("e1", "Djokovic", "Alcaraz", "2026-03-01")]
    assert resolve_result(make_result("Djokovic", "Sinner", "2026-03-01"), events) is None
    assert resolve_result(make_result("Djokovic", "Alcaraz", "2026-03-02"), events) is None


def test_resolve_result_matches_normalized_names_and_date():
    events = [make_event("e1", "djokovic n", "alcaraz c", "2026-03-01")]
    result = make_result("Djokovic N.", "Alcaraz C.", "2026-03-01")
    assert resolve_result(result, events) == "e1"


def test_parse_tennis_results_reads_csv_fixture():
    rows = parse_tennis_results("tests/results/fixtures/tennis_results.csv")
    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert rows[0].participant_a == "Djokovic N."
    assert rows[0].participant_b == "Alcaraz C."
    assert rows[0].date == "2026-03-01"
    assert rows[0].score == "6-4 6-4"
    assert rows[0].league == "ATP Dubai"


def test_ingest_tennis_results_stores_resolved_rows(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "bet.sqlite"))
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(make_event("e1", "Djokovic N.", "Alcaraz C.", "2026-03-01"))
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(make_event("e2", "Alcaraz C.", "Djokovic N.", "2026-03-02"))

    inserted = ingest_tennis_results("tests/results/fixtures/tennis_results.csv", repo)

    assert inserted == 2
    rows = repo.results()
    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert {r["event_uid"] for r in rows} == {"e1", "e2"}
    assert all(r["source"] == "tennis-data" for r in rows)

    # idempotent on same source/event
    assert ingest_tennis_results("tests/results/fixtures/tennis_results.csv", repo) == 0
    assert len(repo.results()) == 2

FILE: tests/risk/test_engine.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.backtest.engine import BacktestReport, Signal
from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import AdapterHealth
from betdash.risk.engine import ExposureState, RiskDecision, RiskEngine, RiskLimits


T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
START = datetime(2026, 1, 10, 18, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


@dataclass
class _Signal:
    event_uid: str = "e1"
    market: str = "match_winner"
    outcome: str = "p1"
    odds_decimal: float = 2.0
    model_prob: float = 0.6
    observed_at: datetime = T0
    event_start_at: datetime = START
    stake: float = 20.0
    league: str = "ATP"
    sport: str = "tennis"
    correlation_key: str = "e1:match_winner"


def healthy_adapter_health():
    return [AdapterHealth("b1", "ok", None, 0, "v1"), AdapterHealth("b2", "ok", None, 0, "v1")]


@dataclass
class _Report:
    predictions: list = field(default_factory=list)
    clv_sample_count: int = 0
    signals: list = field(default_factory=list)
    loss: float = 0.0
    adapter_health: list = field(default_factory=healthy_adapter_health)
    event_exposure: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    league_exposure: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    sport_exposure: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    correlated_exposure: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def make_signal(stake=20, **kw):
    return _Signal(stake=stake, **kw)


def make_report(loss=120, **kw):
    return _Report(loss=loss, **kw)


def test_daily_loss_limit_skips_signal():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=100.0))
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(stake=20), make_report(loss=120))
    assert decision.status == "skipped"


def test_max_stake_per_signal_skipped():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(max_stake_per_signal=10.0))
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(stake=20), make_report(loss=0))
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "max_stake_per_signal" in decision.reasons


def test_max_exposure_per_event_skipped():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(max_exposure_per_event=50.0))
    state = ExposureState(event_exposure={"e1": 40.0})
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(stake=20, event_uid="e1"), make_report(loss=0), state=state)
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "max_exposure_per_event" in decision.reasons


def test_max_exposure_per_league_skipped():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(max_exposure_per_league=50.0))
    state = ExposureState(league_exposure={"ATP": 40.0})
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(stake=20, league="ATP"), make_report(loss=0), state=state)
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "max_exposure_per_league" in decision.reasons


def test_max_exposure_per_sport_skipped():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(max_exposure_per_sport=50.0))
    state = ExposureState(sport_exposure={"tennis": 45.0})
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(stake=10, sport="tennis"), make_report(loss=0), state=state)
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "max_exposure_per_sport" in decision.reasons


def test_correlation_limit_skips_highly_related_outcomes():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(max_correlated_exposure=30.0))
    state = ExposureState(correlated_exposure={"e1:match_winner": 25.0})
    decision = engine.evaluate(
        make_signal(stake=10, correlation_key="e1:match_winner"),
        make_report(loss=0),
        state=state,
    )
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "correlation_limit" in decision.reasons


def test_kill_switch_on_adapter_health_below_threshold():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(min_adapter_health=0.5))
    health = [
        AdapterHealth("b1", "ok", None, 0, "v1"),
        AdapterHealth("b2", "degraded", None, 3, "v1"),
        AdapterHealth("b3", "down", None, 5, "v1"),
    ]
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(), make_report(loss=0), adapter_health=health)
    assert decision.status == "kill_switch"
    assert "kill_switch_adapter_health" in decision.reasons


def test_kill_switch_on_anomalous_odds():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(), limits=RiskLimits(anomalous_odds_low=1.01, anomalous_odds_high=100.0))
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(odds_decimal=500.0), make_report(loss=0))
    assert decision.status == "kill_switch"
    assert "kill_switch_anomalous_odds" in decision.reasons


def test_allowed_signal_returns_decision_with_reason_codes():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=1000.0), limits=RiskLimits(max_stake_per_signal=100.0))
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(stake=10), make_report(loss=0))
    assert decision.status == "allowed"
    assert decision.reasons == ("allowed",)
    assert isinstance(decision, RiskDecision)


def test_evaluate_accepts_backtest_report_and_signal_types():
    # Interface contract: evaluate(signal: Signal, report: BacktestReport)
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=1000.0))
    sig = Signal(
        event_uid="e1",
        market="match_winner",
        outcome="p1",
        odds_decimal=2.0,
        model_prob=0.6,
        observed_at=T0,
        event_start_at=START,
    )
    report = BacktestReport(predictions=[], clv_sample_count=0, signals=[sig])
    decision = engine.evaluate(sig, report, adapter_health=healthy_adapter_health())
    assert decision.status in {"allowed", "skipped", "kill_switch"}
    assert isinstance(decision.reasons, tuple)


def test_kill_switch_takes_precedence_over_skip_reasons():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=10.0), limits=RiskLimits(min_adapter_health=0.8))
    health = [AdapterHealth("b1", "down", None, 1, "v1")]
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(odds_decimal=999.0), make_report(loss=999.0), adapter_health=health)
    assert decision.status == "kill_switch"
    assert "kill_switch_adapter_health" in decision.reasons


def test_daily_loss_uses_explicit_state_over_zero_report_loss():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=100.0))
    state = ExposureState(daily_loss=120.0)
    decision = engine.evaluate(
        make_signal(stake=20),
        make_report(loss=0),
        state=state,
        adapter_health=healthy_adapter_health(),
    )
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "max_daily_loss" in decision.reasons


def test_daily_loss_uses_max_of_state_and_report_when_state_passed():
    """Stale/zero ExposureState must not bypass a higher report loss."""
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=100.0))
    state = ExposureState(daily_loss=0.0)
    decision = engine.evaluate(
        make_signal(stake=20),
        make_report(loss=120),
        state=state,
        adapter_health=healthy_adapter_health(),
    )
    assert decision.status == "skipped"
    assert "max_daily_loss" in decision.reasons


def test_missing_adapter_health_fails_closed():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=1000.0))

    @dataclass
    class ReportNoHealth:
        predictions: list = field(default_factory=list)
        clv_sample_count: int = 0
        signals: list = field(default_factory=list)
        loss: float = 0.0

    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(), ReportNoHealth())
    assert decision.status == "kill_switch"
    assert "kill_switch_adapter_health_unknown" in decision.reasons


def test_empty_adapter_health_fails_closed():
    engine = RiskEngine(Settings(max_daily_loss=1000.0))
    decision = engine.evaluate(make_signal(), make_report(loss=0), adapter_health=[])
    assert decision.status == "kill_switch"
    assert "kill_switch_adapter_health_unknown" in decision.reasons




FILE: tests/tennis/test_blend.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from betdash.tennis.blend import blend_score_distributions, fit_blend_weight


def test_blend_preserves_total_mass_and_union_of_atoms():
    empirical = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.7, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.3}
    markov = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((7, 6), (6, 4)): 0.6}

    blended = blend_score_distributions(empirical, markov, 0.5)

    assert abs(sum(blended.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
    assert set(blended) == set(empirical) | set(markov)


def test_fit_blend_weight_prefers_accurate_provider_on_oof_pairs():
    correct = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.9, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.1}
    wrong = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.1, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.9}
    pairs = [
        {"empirical": correct, "markov": wrong, "actual": ((6, 4), (6, 3))},
        {"empirical": correct, "markov": wrong, "actual": ((6, 4), (6, 3))},
        {"empirical": correct, "markov": wrong, "actual": ((6, 4), (6, 3))},
    ]

    weight, losses = fit_blend_weight(pairs)

    assert weight > 0.5
    assert losses["empirical"] < losses["markov"]
    assert "blend" in losses




FILE: tests/tennis/test_distribution.py

import pytest

from betdash.tennis.distribution import (
    condition_distribution_on_win_prob,
    empirical_score_distribution,
)
from betdash.tennis.markets import market_probabilities


def test_empirical_distribution_uses_similar_matches_and_sums_to_one():
    history = [
        {"score_p1_first": "6-4 6-3", "surface": "clay", "best_of": 3, "elo_gap": 80, "tourney_level": "A", "round": "R32"},
        {"score_p1_first": "3-6 6-7", "surface": "clay", "best_of": 3, "elo_gap": -70, "tourney_level": "A", "round": "R32"},
        {"score_p1_first": "6-2 6-2", "surface": "grass", "best_of": 3, "elo_gap": 90, "tourney_level": "A", "round": "R32"},
    ]
    target = {"surface": "clay", "best_of": 3, "elo_gap": 75, "tourney_level": "A", "round": "R32"}

    dist = empirical_score_distribution(history, target, prior_strength=0.0)

    assert sum(dist.values()) == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert dist[((6, 4), (6, 3))] == pytest.approx(0.5)


def test_condition_distribution_shifts_match_winner_without_losing_mass():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.5, ((3, 6), (6, 7)): 0.5}

    shifted = condition_distribution_on_win_prob(dist, 0.8)

    assert sum(shifted.values()) == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert market_probabilities(shifted, "match_winner")["p1"] == pytest.approx(0.8)

import sqlite3

from betdash.data.sackmann import ensure_sackmann_tables
from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.tennis.empirical_provider import (
    empirical_provider_distribution,
    sackmann_history_rows,
)

P1 = "name:Novak Djokovic"
P2 = "name:Carlos Alcaraz"
TARGET = {
    "surface": "Hard",
    "best_of": 3,
    "tourney_level": "A",
    "round": "R32",
    "elo_gap": 50.0,
    "observed_at": "2023-12-01",
}


def _seed(db_path):
    with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        rows = [
            ("2023-001", "20230101", "Novak Djokovic", "Carlos Alcaraz", "6-4 6-3", 5, 20),
            ("2023-002", "20230201", "Carlos Alcaraz", "Novak Djokovic", "6-2 6-1", 5, 20),
            ("2024-001", "20240101", "Novak Djokovic", "Carlos Alcaraz", "6-0 6-0", 5, 20),
        ]
        for tid, date, winner, loser, score, wrank, lrank in rows:
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (
                    tour, tourney_id, surface, tourney_level, round, tourney_date,
                    winner_name, loser_name, score, best_of, winner_rank, loser_rank
                ) VALUES ('atp', ?, 'Hard', 'A', 'R32', ?, ?, ?, ?, 3, ?, ?)
                """,
                (tid, date, winner, loser, score, wrank, lrank),
            )


def test_history_rows_are_oriented_to_p1_and_strictly_pre_event(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "history.db"
    _seed(db)
    repo = Repository(str(db))

    rows = sackmann_history_rows(repo, P1, P2, TARGET)

    assert len(rows) == 2
    assert rows[0]["score_p1_first"] == "6-4 6-3"
    assert rows[1]["score_p1_first"] == "2-6 1-6"
    assert rows[0]["elo_gap"] > 0
    assert rows[1]["elo_gap"] < 0


def test_provider_builds_distribution_from_oriented_history(tmp_path):
    db = tmp_path / "provider.db"
    _seed(db)
    repo = Repository(str(db))

    dist = empirical_provider_distribution(repo, P1, P2, TARGET)

    assert ((6, 4), (6, 3)) in dist
    assert ((2, 6), (1, 6)) in dist
    assert abs(sum(dist.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9

import betdash.tennis as tennis
from betdash.tennis.evaluation import evaluation_report


def test_evaluation_report_separates_accuracy_and_value():
    pair = {
        "distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.7, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.3},
        "actual_score": "6-4 6-3",
        "market_probability": 0.6,
        "market_odds": 2.0,
        "observed_at": "2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00",
        "actual": 1,
    }

    report = evaluation_report([pair])

    assert report["oof_samples"] == 1
    assert 0.0 <= report["result_brier"] <= 1.0
    assert 0.0 <= report["score_log_loss"] <= 1.0
    assert report["value_ev"] > 0.0


def test_evaluation_report_does_not_claim_value_without_market_probability():
    pair = {"distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 1.0}, "actual_score": "6-4 6-3", "actual": 1}

    report = evaluation_report([pair])

    assert report["value_samples"] == 0
    assert report["value_ev"] is None


def test_evaluation_report_uses_chronological_pairs_only():
    rows = [
        {"distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.6, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.4}, "actual_score": "6-4 6-3", "actual": 1, "observed_at": "2026-01-02T12:00:00+00:00"},
        {"distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.6}, "actual_score": "4-6 3-6", "actual": 0, "observed_at": "2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"},
    ]

    report = evaluation_report(rows)

    assert report["oof_samples"] == 2
    assert report["first_observed_at"] == "2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"
    assert report["last_observed_at"] == "2026-01-02T12:00:00+00:00"

from datetime import datetime, timezone
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from typing import Any

from betdash.app.dashboard import score_market_rows
from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.data.sackmann import ensure_sackmann_tables
from betdash.tennis.empirical_provider import (
    empirical_provider_distribution,
    sackmann_history_rows,
)


def _seed_sackmann(repo: Repository) -> None:
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        ensure_sackmann_tables(conn)
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO sackmann_matches (
                tour, tourney_id, tourney_name, surface, draw_size, tourney_level,
                tourney_date, match_num, winner_id, winner_name, loser_id, loser_name,
                score, best_of, round, winner_rank, loser_rank
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                "atp", "t1", "Open", "Hard", 32, "A", "20260101", 1,
                1, "Novak Djokovic", 2, "Carlos Alcaraz", "6-4 6-3", 3, "R32", 10, 20,
            ),
        )


def test_empirical_provider_uses_real_history_with_blank_context(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "ctx.db"))
    _seed_sackmann(repo)
    target = {
        "surface": "Hard",
        "best_of": 3,
        "tourney_level": "",
        "round": "",
        "elo_gap": 0.0,
        "observed_at": "2026-11-28",
    }

    dist = empirical_provider_distribution(repo, "name:Новак Джокович", "name:Карлос Алькарас", target)

    assert ((6, 4), (6, 3)) in dist
    assert dist[((6, 4), (6, 3))] > 0.5


def test_empirical_provider_handles_missing_sackmann_table(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "missing.db"))

    assert sackmann_history_rows(repo, "name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz", {}) == []


def test_score_market_rows_uses_newest_distribution():
    now = datetime(2026, 11, 28, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    older = {
        "event_uid": "e1",
        "provider": "blend",
        "observed_at": datetime(2026, 11, 28, 9, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        "distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.9, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.1},
    }
    newer = {
        "event_uid": "e1",
        "provider": "blend",
        "observed_at": now,
        "distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.2, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.8},
    }
    snapshots = [
        Snapshot(
            event_uid="e1",
            bookmaker=book,
            market="match_winner",
            outcome=outcome,
            odds_decimal=odds,
            observed_at=now,
            source_event_id="s1",
            adapter_version="test",
        )
        for book, outcome, odds in (
            ("a", "p1", 2.0), ("a", "p2", 2.0),
            ("b", "p1", 2.1), ("b", "p2", 2.3),
        )
    ]

    rows = score_market_rows([older, newer], snapshots, "blend")

    assert rows[0]["outcome"] == "p2"
    assert rows[0]["model_prob"] == 0.8


def test_trainer_honors_best_of_and_blend_weight(monkeypatch):
    import betdash.models.trainer as trainer_module
    from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent

    captured: dict[str, Any] = {}
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer_module, "build_features", lambda *a, **k: {"best_of": 5}
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer_module,
        "empirical_provider_distribution",
        lambda *a, **k: {((6, 4), (6, 3), (6, 4)): 1.0},
    )
    def _markov(p1, p2, best_of, **kwargs):
        captured["best_of"] = best_of
        return {((6, 4), (4, 6), (7, 5)): 1.0}

    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer_module, "markov_score_distribution", _markov)
    event = CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e5",
        sport="tennis",
        league="Test",
        participant_ids=("name:P1", "name:P2"),
        start_at="2026-11-28T12:00:00Z",
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )

    rows = trainer_module.build_score_distribution_rows(
        event, object(), 0.6, "run-5", datetime(2026, 11, 28, tzinfo=timezone.utc), blend_weight=0.8
    )

    assert captured["best_of"] == 5
    assert rows[-1]["blend_weight"] == 0.8


def test_empirical_provider_imports_standalone():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", "from betdash.tennis.empirical_provider import empirical_provider_distribution"],
        env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": "src"},
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr

from betdash.tennis.markets import market_probabilities, resolve_tennis_market
from betdash.tennis.score import parse_tennis_score


def test_market_probabilities_match_winner_and_game_handicap():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((4, 6), (5, 7)): 0.6}

    wp = market_probabilities(dist, "match_winner")
    assert wp["p1"] == 0.4
    assert wp["p2"] == 0.6

    gc = market_probabilities(dist, "game_handicap", line=2.0)
    assert gc["push"] == 0.0
    assert gc["p1"] == 0.4
    assert gc["p2"] == 0.6


def test_set_markets_use_requested_set():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((4, 6), (5, 7)): 0.6}

    total = market_probabilities(dist, "set_total", line=10.5, set_index=2)
    assert total["over"] == 0.6
    assert total["under"] == 0.4

    handicap = market_probabilities(dist, "set_game_handicap", line=1.5, set_index=2)
    assert handicap["p1"] == 0.4
    assert handicap["p2"] == 0.6


def test_combined_market_uses_joint_probability():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((7, 6), (6, 4)): 0.3, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.3}

    comb = market_probabilities(dist, "winner_plus_total", line=22.5)
    assert comb["p1_over"] == 0.3
    assert comb["p1_under"] == 0.4
    assert comb["p2_over"] + comb["p2_under"] == 0.3


def test_bookmaker_market_aliases_resolve_to_tennis_markets():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((4, 6), (5, 7)): 0.6}

    total = market_probabilities(dist, "total_points", line=19.5)
    assert total == market_probabilities(dist, "total_games", line=19.5)

    spread = market_probabilities(dist, "spread", line=1.5)
    assert spread == market_probabilities(dist, "game_handicap", line=1.5)


def test_exact_integer_totals_create_push():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.4, ((4, 6), (5, 7)): 0.6}

    totals = market_probabilities(dist, "total_games", line=19.0)
    assert totals["push"] == 0.4
    assert totals["over"] == 0.6


def test_resolve_market_returns_push_for_void_totals():
    score = parse_tennis_score("6-4 3-2 RET", "retired")

    assert resolve_tennis_market("total_games", 10.5, "over", score, "p1") == 0.5




FILE: tests/tennis/test_markov.py

from betdash.tennis.markov import (
    markov_score_distribution,
    point_probability_from_serve,
)


def test_point_probability_blends_serve_and_return():
    stats = {"svc_pts": 100, "svc_won": 80, "ret_pts": 100, "ret_won": 30}

    assert point_probability_from_serve(stats) == 0.55


def test_markov_bo3_distribution_is_valid_and_deterministic():
    first = markov_score_distribution(0.55, 0.45, best_of=3, simulations=500, seed=11)
    second = markov_score_distribution(0.55, 0.45, best_of=3, simulations=500, seed=11)

    assert first == second
    assert abs(sum(first.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
    assert all(len(atom) in (2, 3) for atom in first)
    assert all(0 <= a <= 7 and 0 <= b <= 7 for atom in first for a, b in atom)


def test_markov_bo5_distribution_can_have_three_to_five_sets():
    dist = markov_score_distribution(0.52, 0.48, best_of=5, simulations=500, seed=12)

    assert abs(sum(dist.values()) - 1.0) < 1e-9
    assert any(len(atom) >= 3 for atom in dist)


def test_strong_player_dominates_markov_distribution():
    dist = markov_score_distribution(0.85, 0.15, best_of=3, simulations=1000, seed=13)

    p1_mass = sum(
        probability
        for atom, probability in dist.items()
        if sum(1 for a, b in atom if a > b) > sum(1 for a, b in atom if b > a)
    )
    assert p1_mass > 0.95




FILE: tests/tennis/test_markov_serve_aware.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from betdash.tennis.markov import markov_score_distribution


def _p1_winner_prob(distribution):
    return sum(
        probability
        for atom, probability in distribution.items()
        if sum(left > right for left, right in atom) > sum(left < right for left, right in atom)
    )


def test_asymmetric_hold_rates_change_winner_probability():
    strong = markov_score_distribution(0.78, 0.52, simulations=3000, seed=11)
    weak = markov_score_distribution(0.52, 0.78, simulations=3000, seed=11)

    assert _p1_winner_prob(strong) > 0.85
    assert _p1_winner_prob(weak) < 0.15


def test_tiebreak_flag_changes_score_distribution():
    with_tiebreak = markov_score_distribution(0.56, 0.54, simulations=3000, seed=5, tiebreak=True)
    without_tiebreak = markov_score_distribution(0.56, 0.54, simulations=3000, seed=5, tiebreak=False)

    assert with_tiebreak != without_tiebreak

from pathlib import Path

from betdash.config import Settings
from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.models.trainer import Trainer


def _oof_row(event_uid, day, actual, strength):
    return {
        "event_uid": event_uid,
        "event_start_at": f"2026-01-{day:02d}T00:00:00Z",
        "actual": actual,
        "features": {"elo_p1": strength},
        "market_p1": strength,
    }


def test_oof_rows_are_time_sorted_and_actual_filtered(tmp_path):
    trainer = Trainer(Repository(str(tmp_path / "oof.db")), Settings())
    late = [
        _oof_row("late0", 4, 1, 0.8),
        _oof_row("late1", 5, 0, 0.3),
    ]
    early = [
        _oof_row("early0", 1, 1, 0.7),
        _oof_row("early1", 2, 0, 0.4),
    ]
    shuffled = late + early + [_oof_row("bad", 3, None, 0.5)]

    got = trainer._walk_forward_oof_rows(shuffled, window=1)
    expected = trainer._walk_forward_oof_rows(early + late, window=1)

    assert [(p, a, r["event_uid"]) for p, a, r in got] == [
        (p, a, r["event_uid"]) for p, a, r in expected
    ]


def test_step_computes_oof_rows_once_and_passes_to_metrics(tmp_path):
    source = (Path(Trainer.__module__.replace(".", "/"))).with_suffix(".py")
    text = source.read_text() if source.exists() else ""
    if not text:
        text = Path("src/betdash/models/trainer.py").read_text()

    assert "oof_rows = self._walk_forward_oof_rows(processed_rows)" in text
    assert "oof_rows=oof_rows" in text
    assert text.count("self._walk_forward_oof_rows(rows)") == 1


def test_walk_forward_summary_comes_from_oof_rows(tmp_path):
    trainer = Trainer(Repository(str(tmp_path / "summary.db")), Settings())
    oof_rows = [(0.8, 1, {"event_uid": "e1"}), (0.3, 0, {"event_uid": "e2"})]

    summary = trainer._walk_forward_summary_from_oof_rows(oof_rows, window=1)

    assert summary["predictions"] == 2
    assert summary["correct"] == 2
    assert summary["accuracy"] == 1.0
    assert [fold["fold"] for fold in summary["folds"]] == [1, 2]


def test_step_does_not_run_a_second_walk_forward():
    text = Path("src/betdash/models/trainer.py").read_text()

    assert "wf = self._walk_forward_summary_from_oof_rows(oof_rows)" in text
    assert "wf = self._walk_forward(processed_rows)" not in text


def test_blend_repository_lookup_is_indexed_by_event_uid():
    text = Path("src/betdash/tennis/blend.py").read_text()

    assert "by_event.setdefault(uid, [])" in text
    assert "for run_id, distributions in by_event.get(uid, ())" in text
    assert "for (event_uid, run_id), distributions in grouped.items()" not in text

import pytest

from betdash.tennis.distribution import empirical_score_distribution
from betdash.tennis.markets import market_probabilities, resolve_tennis_market
from betdash.tennis.score import parse_tennis_score
from betdash.tennis.evaluation import evaluation_report


def test_p2_settlement_preserves_void_totals():
    score = parse_tennis_score("6-4 6-3 RET", "retired")

    assert resolve_tennis_market("total_games", 18.5, "over", score, "p1") == 0.5
    assert resolve_tennis_market("total_games", 18.5, "over", score, "p2") == 0.5


def test_match_winner_tied_score_is_push():
    outcomes = market_probabilities({((1, 1),): 1.0}, "match_winner")

    assert outcomes["push"] == 1.0


def test_tied_seven_seven_is_not_a_finished_set():
    score = parse_tennis_score("7-7")

    assert score is not None
    assert not score.completed
    assert score.winner_side is None


def test_two_number_tiebreak_is_stripped():
    score = parse_tennis_score("7-6(4-2) 6-4")

    assert score is not None
    assert score.sets == ((7, 6), (6, 4))
    assert score.totals_reliable


def test_match_tiebreak_detects_ten_seven():
    score = parse_tennis_score("6-7(5) 7-6(3) 10-7")

    assert score is not None
    assert score.match_tiebreak
    assert not score.totals_reliable


def test_distribution_falls_back_to_smoothed_prior():
    dist = empirical_score_distribution([], {"best_of": 3}, prior_strength=5.0)

    assert dist
    assert sum(dist.values()) == pytest.approx(1.0)


def test_distribution_skips_unreliable_history():
    context = {"surface": "clay", "best_of": 3, "elo_gap": 80, "tourney_level": "A", "round": "R32"}
    history = [
        {**context, "score_p1_first": "6-4 3-2 RET", "comment": "retired"},
        {**context, "score_p1_first": "6-4 6-3"},
    ]

    dist = empirical_score_distribution(history, context, prior_strength=0.0)

    assert ((6, 4), (3, 2)) not in dist
    assert dist[((6, 4), (6, 3))] == pytest.approx(1.0)


def test_distribution_excludes_future_rows():
    context = {"surface": "clay", "best_of": 3, "elo_gap": 80, "tourney_level": "A", "round": "R32"}
    history = [
        {**context, "score_p1_first": "6-4 6-3", "observed_at": "2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"},
        {**context, "score_p1_first": "3-6 6-3 6-2", "observed_at": "2026-01-03T12:00:00+00:00"},
    ]
    target = {**context, "observed_at": "2026-01-02T12:00:00+00:00"}

    dist = empirical_score_distribution(history, target, prior_strength=0.0)

    assert dist[((6, 4), (6, 3))] == pytest.approx(1.0)


def test_comment_substrings_do_not_force_void_flags():
    clean = parse_tennis_score("6-4 6-3", "two clean sets")
    returned = parse_tennis_score("6-4 6-3", "return of player")

    assert clean is not None and not clean.walkover and clean.totals_reliable
    assert returned is not None and not returned.retirement and returned.totals_reliable


def test_set_totals_survive_match_tiebreak():
    dist = {((6, 4), (6, 3), (10, 7)): 1.0}

    sets = market_probabilities(dist, "total_sets", line=2.5)
    first_set = market_probabilities(dist, "set_total", line=9.5, set_index=1)

    assert sets["over"] == 1.0
    assert first_set["over"] == 1.0


def test_value_ev_requires_real_odds_and_model_probability():
    base = {
        "distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 0.7, ((4, 6), (3, 6)): 0.3},
        "actual_score": "6-4 6-3",
        "actual": 1,
        "market_probability": 0.6,
        "market_odds": 2.0,
    }

    assert evaluation_report([base])["value_ev"] > 0
    assert evaluation_report([{**base, "market_odds": 1.0}])["value_samples"] == 0
    assert evaluation_report([{**base, "distribution": {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 1.0}}])["value_ev"] is None

FILE: tests/test_closing.py

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.normalize.models import RawOdd
from betdash.normalize.registry import EntityRegistry, normalize_event
from betdash.backtest.closing import refresh_closing_lines


def _event(start_at: str):
    reg = EntityRegistry({"P1": "p1", "P2": "p2"})
    return normalize_event(RawOdd(
        bookmaker="bk1", source_event_id="e1", sport="tennis", league="L",
        participants=("P1", "P2"), market="match_winner", outcome="p1", odds_decimal=2.0,
        observed_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc), is_live=False,
        start_at=datetime.fromisoformat(start_at),
    ), reg)


def test_closing_uses_max_in_primary_window(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "t.sqlite"))
    ev = _event("2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(ev)
    from betdash.db.repository import Snapshot
    repo.save_snapshots([
        Snapshot(event_uid=ev.event_uid, bookmaker="b1", market="match_winner", outcome="p1", odds_decimal=2.0, observed_at=datetime.fromisoformat("2026-01-01T11:20:00+00:00"), source_event_id="e1", adapter_version="t"),
        Snapshot(event_uid=ev.event_uid, bookmaker="b2", market="match_winner", outcome="p1", odds_decimal=2.3, observed_at=datetime.fromisoformat("2026-01-01T11:40:00+00:00"), source_event_id="e1", adapter_version="t"),
        Snapshot(event_uid=ev.event_uid, bookmaker="b3", market="match_winner", outcome="p1", odds_decimal=9.0, observed_at=datetime.fromisoformat("2026-01-01T12:10:00+00:00"), source_event_id="e1", adapter_version="t"),
    ])
    n = refresh_closing_lines(repo, close_window_minutes=60, fallback_window_hours=24)
    assert n == 1
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT odds_closing,bookmaker FROM closing_lines").fetchone()
    assert float(row[0]) == 2.3
    assert row[1] == "b2"

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from betdash.backtest.clv import backfill_clv, compute_clv, clv_report
from betdash.backtest.closing import refresh_closing_lines
from betdash.db.repository import Repository, Snapshot
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent


def test_compute_clv_basic():
    assert compute_clv(2.10, 2.00) > 0
    assert compute_clv(1.90, 2.00) < 0
    assert compute_clv(2.00, 2.00) == 0
    assert compute_clv(None, 2.0) is None
    assert compute_clv(1.0, 2.0) is None


def test_clv_compares_same_bookmaker_not_cross_book_max(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "t.sqlite"))
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1", sport="tennis", league="L",
        start_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        participant_ids=("a", "b"), mapping_confidence=1.0,
    ))
    repo.save_snapshots([
        Snapshot(event_uid="e1", bookmaker="b1", market="match_winner", outcome="p1",
                 odds_decimal=2.0, observed_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 11, 20, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
                 source_event_id="e1", adapter_version="t"),
        Snapshot(event_uid="e1", bookmaker="b1", market="match_winner", outcome="p1",
                 odds_decimal=1.8, observed_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 11, 50, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
                 source_event_id="e1", adapter_version="t"),
        Snapshot(event_uid="e1", bookmaker="b2", market="match_winner", outcome="p1",
                 odds_decimal=5.0, observed_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 11, 50, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
                 source_event_id="e1", adapter_version="t"),
    ])
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO predictions(prediction_id,event_uid,market,outcome,model_prob,odds_decimal,bookmaker,observed_at,event_start_at) "
            "VALUES('pred-1','e1','match_winner','p1',0.55,2.0,'b1','2026-01-01T10:00:00+00:00','2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00')"
        )
        conn.commit()
    refresh_closing_lines(repo, close_window_minutes=10)
    assert backfill_clv(repo) == 1
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT closing_odds, clv FROM predictions").fetchone()
    assert float(row["closing_odds"]) == 1.8
    assert float(row["clv"]) > 0.1


def test_clv_report_has_robust_stats(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "t.sqlite"))
    repo.upsert_canonical_event(CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1", sport="tennis", league="L", start_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        participant_ids=("a", "b"), mapping_confidence=1.0,
    ))
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.executemany("INSERT INTO predictions(prediction_id,event_uid,market,outcome,model_prob,odds_decimal,observed_at,created_at,clv) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", [
            ("p1","e1","match_winner","p1",0.5,2.0,"2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00","2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00",0.1),
            ("p2","e1","match_winner","p1",0.5,2.0,"2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00","2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00",0.0),
            ("p3","e1","match_winner","p1",0.5,2.0,"2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00","2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00",-0.1),
            ("p4","e1","match_winner","p1",0.5,2.0,"2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00","2026-01-01T09:00:00+00:00",8.0),
        ])
        conn.commit()
    rep = clv_report(repo, min_samples=1)
    assert "by_sport" not in rep
    o = rep["overall"]
    assert o["n"] == 4
    assert o["median"] == 0.05  # median of [-0.1,0,0.1,8.0]
    assert o["p90"] is not None
    assert o["trimmed_mean"] is not None
    assert o["outlier_pct"] > 0

from betdash.adapters.marathon import _JSON_MARKET_MODELS
from betdash.models.trainer import TENNIS_MARKETS
from betdash.normalize.registry import canon_market
from betdash.tennis.markets import canonical_tennis_market


def test_game_handicap_is_canonical_tennis_market():
    assert canon_market("game_handicap", "test") == "game_handicap"
    assert canon_market("spread", "test") == "game_handicap"
    assert canonical_tennis_market("game_handicap") == "game_handicap"
    assert "game_handicap" in TENNIS_MARKETS

    assert _JSON_MARKET_MODELS["MTCH_HBP"] == "game_handicap"

from pathlib import Path

from betdash.backtest.clv import backfill_clv
from betdash.db.repository import Repository

    assert "with self._lock:\n            pass" not in text

def test_backfill_clv_does_not_erase_existing_clv(tmp_path):
    repo = Repository(str(tmp_path / "clv.sqlite"))
    with repo._connect() as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO predictions(prediction_id,event_uid,market,outcome,model_prob,odds_decimal,clv,observed_at,event_start_at) "
            "VALUES('pred-1','e1','match_winner','p1',0.55,2.0,0.2,'2026-01-01T10:00:00+00:00','2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00')"
        )
        conn.commit()

    backfill_clv(repo)

    with repo._connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT clv FROM predictions WHERE prediction_id='pred-1'").fetchone()
    assert float(row["clv"]) == 0.2




FILE: tests/test_numeric_feature_context.py
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from betdash.db.repository import Repository
from betdash.models import features, trainer
from betdash.normalize.models import CanonicalEvent


def _event() -> CanonicalEvent:
    return CanonicalEvent(
        event_uid="e1",
        sport="tennis",
        league="ATP",
        participant_ids=("name:Novak Djokovic", "name:Carlos Alcaraz"),
        start_at=datetime(2026, 11, 28, 12, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        mapping_confidence=1.0,
    )


def test_build_features_keeps_model_features_numeric(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        features,
        "_tennis_sackmann_features",
        lambda repo, p1, p2, start_at: {"surface": "clay", "best_of": 5},
    )

    result = features.build_features(_event(), Repository(str(tmp_path / "f.db")))

    assert isinstance(result["surface"], (int, float))
    assert result["surface_name"] == "clay"
    assert result["best_of"] == 5


def test_score_distribution_uses_surface_name(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        trainer,
        "build_features",
        lambda *a, **k: {
            "surface": 0.0,
            "surface_name": "hard",
            "best_of": 5,
            "p1_srv_win": 0.65,
            "p2_srv_win": 0.55,
            "p1_ret_win": 0.35,
            "p2_ret_win": 0.45,
            "p1_elo_blend": 1600.0,
            "p2_elo_blend": 1500.0,
        },
    )
    captured = {}

    def fake_empirical(repo, p1, p2, target):
        captured["target"] = target
        return {((6, 4), (6, 3)): 1.0}

    monkeypatch.setattr(trainer, "empirical_provider_distribution", fake_empirical)

    trainer.build_score_distribution_rows(
        _event(), object(), 0.6, "run-1", datetime(2026, 11, 28, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    )

    assert captured["target"]["surface"] == "hard"

from pathlib import Path


BANNED = (
    "basketball", "dota2", "cs2", "NBA", "football", "hockey",
    "map_winner", "total_maps", "map_handicap",
)
ALLOW = {"tests/db/test_tennis_migration.py"}


def test_src_has_no_non_tennis_tokens():
    offenders: list[str] = []
    for path in Path("src/betdash").rglob("*.py"):
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
        for token in BANNED:
            if token.lower() in text:
                offenders.append(f"{path}:{token}")
    assert not offenders, "non-tennis tokens in src: " + ", ".join(offenders)

def test_known_unused_source_imports_are_removed():
    checks = {
        "backtest/clv.py": "from typing import Any",
        "normalize/alias_generator.py": "from typing import Iterable",
        "tennis/markets.py": "from typing import Any",
    }
    for relative, import_line in checks.items():
        assert import_line not in (SRC / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_known_unused_test_imports_are_removed():
    import ast

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    checks = {
        "tests/adapters/test_json_family.py": {"SCOPE_MARKETS"},
        "tests/adapters/test_winline.py": {"pytest"},
        "tests/results/test_resolve.py": {"timezone"},
        "tests/backtest/test_engine.py": {"timedelta"},
        "tests/models/test_baseline.py": {"Settings"},
        "tests/models/test_model_review_fixes.py": {"fit_isotonic"},
        "tests/risk/test_engine.py": {"PredictionRecord"},
        "tests/analytics/test_movement.py": {"datetime", "timezone", "timedelta"},
    }
    for relative, names in checks.items():
        tree = ast.parse((root / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        imported = set()
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                imported.update(a.asname or a.name.split(".")[0] for a in node.names)
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                imported.update(a.asname or a.name for a in node.names)
        assert not (imported & names), f"{relative}: {sorted(imported & names)}"
